We present a lightweight and interpretable decision framework for dynamic edge server selection in latency-critical applications that explicitly accounts for tail risk and switching stability. Each candidate server is characterised by predictive mean and uncertainty summaries of network latency, which are used to estimate the risk of service-level objective (SLO) violations and to guide selection. Risk is evaluated using a tight Normal approximation complemented by a conservative Cantelli bound, while percentile-based scoring coupled with hysteresis stabilizes decisions and suppresses oscillatory switching under short-lived network fluctuations.
  Experimental results on a multi-server edge testbed with a strict SLO of $τ= 0.5$\,s show that the proposed approach reduces the deadline-miss rate from 39\% to 34\% compared to a mean-only baseline, while reducing switching frequency from 46\% to 5.5\% ($\approx$88\% reduction) and maintaining sub-SLO average latency ($\approx$0.45\,s). These results demonstrate that explicit risk evaluation combined with stability-preserving control enables practical and robust adaptive server selection in dynamic edge environments.

AI.tldr: 本文（IWCMC 2026录用）提出一个面向时延敏感边缘应用的"轻量级、可解释"动态边缘服务器选择决策层：在滑动窗口内为每台候选服务器维护时延的预测均值 μ 与标准差 σ，用高斯近似估计 SLO 违约概率，并以单侧 Cantelli 界作为分布失配下的保守兜底；再以 μ+kσ 的百分位评分 + 滞回（hysteresis）机制抑制切换振荡。在三服务器真实边缘测试床（SLO τ=0.5 s，ε=0.15，k=1.645，Δ=0.05，N=5）上，相比仅按均值选路的基线，超时未命中率（DMR）由 39% 降至 34%，切换频率由 46% 降至 5.5%，平均时延约 0.429–0.45 s，保持在 SLO 之内；另基于 containerlab 的 10 服务器回放验证了线性计算开销与收敛到少数低风险候选的稳定性。
AI.motivation: 边缘计算中的时延敏感应用（智能交通、协同感知、路侧视频分析等）对端到端时延有严格 SLO 约束，动态服务器选择是关键问题。作者指出已有工作多聚焦于轻量级时延预测模型或可靠性评分，但存在两个缺口：(1) 仅按预测均值选服务器忽略时延波动性与预测不确定性，可能低估 SLO 违约风险，在共享、时变网络中尤其危险；(2) 朴素的反应式策略对短时波动过于敏感，导致服务器之间振荡切换，引发连接重置、瞬时丢包、预热延迟等切换开销，反而抬高尾时延。作者前序工作已提出近饱和区间非线性时延的有理模型与可靠性评分，但仍属"均值驱动"，缺乏把不确定性预测转化为显式风险与稳定动作的决策层。因此需要一个仅依赖端到端可观测指标（黑盒、无需内部队列状态或离线训练）即可运行的决策层，同时兼顾风险感知与切换稳定性。
AI.method:
形式化：K 台候选边缘服务器，客户端按帧持续卸载；决策层在最近 W 个观测的滑动窗口上计算每台服务器的均值 μ_i 与标准差 σ_i（样本不足时按已有历史计算，并按帧聚合以降低抖动与测量噪声敏感度），以高斯代理 N_i≈N(μ_i, σ_i²) 近似网络时延，SLO 为 N_i ≤ τ = 500 ms。

风险评估（Algorithm 1 混合风险评估）：p_i^Norm(τ) = 1 − Φ((τ−μ_i)/σ_i)（紧、可解释的近似）；p_i^Cant(τ) = 1/(1+((τ−μ_i)/σ_i)²)（单侧 Cantelli 无分布假设的保守兜底）。对所有服务器计算两个风险值，取 p^Norm 最小者为 j，仅当 p_j^Norm < ε 且 p_j^Cant < ε 时接受该服务器为可行解 S_best，否则返回空集（保持当前服务器）。

评分与稳定性控制（Algorithm 2 百分位滞回）：定义百分位评分 Score_i(k) = μ_i + kσ_i（高斯下对应上侧分位，k=1 对应 84 分位，k=1.645 对应单侧 95 分位），k 为风险厌恶系数。在可行集中取评分最低者为挑战者 j；仅当 Score_curr − Score_j ≥ Δ·Score_curr 且该优势连续保持 N 个决策步（持久计数器 c≥N）时才执行切换并清零计数器，否则维持当前服务器。

假设与局限：短窗口内时延局部平稳；高斯仅为轻量近似（由 Cantelli 兜底）；仅依赖端到端黑盒观测。Δ 与 N 取固定工作点，自适应调参不在范围内。

实验：真实测试床 3 服务器 + 单客户端交通标志检测应用，逐帧一个网络请求；策略对比为（1）仅均值基线、（2）Algorithm 1 混合风险评估、（3）Algorithm 2 百分位+滞回；指标为 DMR（时延超 τ 的帧占比）、平均时延与 P95、以及切换步占比。另做 containerlab 10 服务器回放。
AI.result: 真实测试床结果（表 II）：仅均值基线 平均时延 0.448 s、DMR 39.0%、切换 46.0%；Algorithm 1 平均时延 0.451 s、DMR 34.0%、切换 89.5%（风险感知降低 DMR 5 个百分点，但切换更频繁）；Algorithm 2 平均时延 0.429 s、DMR 34.0%、切换 5.5%（在保持相同 DMR 的同时把切换率从 89.5% 压到 5.5%，且平均时延最低）。滞回窗口敏感性（表 III）：N=2→11.0%、N=3→9.5%、N=4→8.0%、N=5→5.5%、N=6→2.0%、N=8/10→0%，平均时延 0.414–0.431 s、P95 0.472–0.480 s；N=5–6 为稳定性与时延的良好折中，N≥8 在该 trace 上完全消除切换。时延影响并非严格单调。参数敏感性：k=1.645（单侧 95 分位）为稳健默认；Δ=0.05、N=5–6 为推荐工作点；Normal 估计与 Cantelli 界在所有 trace 上给出一致的服务器排序，尽管绝对风险值不同，说明决策逻辑对分布失配稳健。扩展性：单次决策复杂度随服务器数线性增长，仅需对 (μ, σ) 做简单算术运算，无需在线训练、全局协调或长时域优化，支持按客户端/帧去中心化执行；containerlab 10 服务器回放中策略收敛到少数持续低风险候选、切换极少。
AI.conclusion: 显式的风险评估（Normal–Cantelli 混合）与稳定性保持控制（百分位滞回）相结合，可在不依赖服务器内部状态可见性、不需要学习式控制的前提下，把不确定的网络时延摘要转化为既可靠又稳定的边缘服务器选择动作，兼顾可靠性（更少 SLO 违约）、效率（更低平均时延）与稳定性（切换频率下降约一个数量级）。需要注意两处报告口径差异：摘要称切换频率"由 46% 降至 5.5%（约 88% 下降）"是相对仅均值基线，而正文结论强调滞回本身"由 89.5% 降至 5.5%"；同时摘要给出平均时延 ≈0.45 s，正文表 II 为 0.429 s（摘要有轻微不一致）。作者明确指出实验规模有限（3 服务器、单客户端）以隔离决策逻辑本身，多客户端、更多样化工作负载、移动性感知预测以及联合时延—能耗—成本的联邦边缘决策策略留待未来工作。

title: Forget, Then Recall: Learnable Compression and Selective Unfolding via Gist Sparse Attention
summary: Scaling large language models to long contexts is challenging due to the quadratic computational cost of full attention. Mitigation approaches include KV-cache selection or compression techniques. We instead provide an effective and end-to-end learnable bridge between the two without requiring architecture modification. In particular, our key insight is that interleaved gist compression tokens -- which provide a learnable summary of sets of raw tokens -- can serve as routing signals for sparse attention. Building on this, we introduce selective unfolding via GSA, which first compresses the context into gist tokens, then selects the most relevant gists, and subsequently restores the corresponding raw chunks for detailed attention. This yields a simple coarse-to-fine mechanism that combines compact global representations with targeted access to fine-grained evidence. We further incorporate this process directly into training in an end-to-end fashion, avoiding the need for external retrieval modules. In addition, we extend the framework hierarchically via recursive gist-of-gist construction, enabling multi-resolution context access with logarithmic per-step decoding complexity. Empirical results on LongBench and RAG benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms other compression baselines as well as inference-time sparse attention methods across compression ratios from $8\times$ to $32\times$. The code is available at: https://github.com/yuzhenmao/gist-sparse-attention/

AI.tldr: GSA是一种无需架构修改的端到端可学习的长上下文处理方法，通过gist压缩token作为路由信号，结合粗粒度全局表示与细粒度证据访问，并通过层级gist-of-gist实现对数复杂度解码。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型处理长上下文时，全注意力计算存在二次方复杂度问题，现有方法如KV-cache选择或压缩技术各有权衡，需要在架构修改与效率之间寻求平衡。
AI.method: 提出选择性展开机制(GSA)：首先将上下文压缩为gist token，再选择最相关的gist，最后恢复对应raw chunk进行详细注意力计算；采用端到端训练避免外部检索模块；通过递归gist-of-gist构建实现层级扩展。
AI.result: 在LongBench和RAG基准上，8×至32×压缩率下持续优于压缩基线方法和推理时稀疏注意力方法。
AI.conclusion: GSA通过交织式gist压缩token作为路由信号，实现了压缩与稀疏注意力的有效结合，在8×到32×压缩率下均优于基线方法和稀疏注意力方法，且支持对数级解码复杂度。

title: Weighting What Matters: Boosting Sample Efficiency in Medical Report Generation via Token Reweighting
summary: Training vision-language models (VLMs) for medical report generation is often hindered by the scarcity of high-quality annotated data. This work evaluates the use of a weighted loss function to improve data efficiency. Compared to standard cross-entropy loss, which treats all token prediction errors equally, the reweighted loss shifts the focus to semantically salient tokens with outsized clinical importance. In experiments on ophthalmological report generation, we show that this simple method improves efficiency across multiple data scales, achieving similar report quality with up to ten times less training data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用加权损失函数替代标准交叉熵损失，通过聚焦临床重要性较高的语义关键token，在眼科报告生成任务中实现数据效率提升，可仅用十分之一的训练数据达到相近的报告质量。
AI.motivation: 医学报告生成任务中，高质量标注数据稀缺，传统交叉熵损失对所有token平等对待，无法突出临床关键信息的重要性，导致模型训练效率低下。
AI.method: 采用加权损失函数重新分配token权重，对具有较大临床意义的语义关键token赋予更高权重，同时保留标准交叉熵作为基础损失框架，在眼科影像报告生成任务上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 该方法在多个数据规模下均表现出更好的数据效率，可在仅使用十分之一训练数据的情况下，达到与标准方法相当的报告生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过简单调整损失函数权重分配策略，可有效缓解医学VLM训练中的数据稀缺问题，该方法具有较高的实用价值和推广潜力。

title: Adaptive Test-Time Compute Allocation with Evolving In-Context Demonstrations
summary: While scaling test-time compute can substantially improve model performance, existing approaches either rely on static compute allocation or sample from fixed generation distributions. In this work, we introduce a test-time compute allocation framework that jointly adapts where computation is spent and how generation is performed. Our method begins with a warm-up phase that identifies easy queries and assembles an initial pool of question-response pairs from the test set itself. An adaptive phase then concentrates further computation on unresolved queries while reshaping their generation distributions through evolving in-context demonstrations -- conditioning each generation on successful responses from semantically related queries rather than resampling from a fixed distribution. Experiments across math, coding, and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms existing baselines while consuming substantially less inference-time compute.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种测试时计算分配框架，通过warm-up阶段识别简单问题并构建问答池，然后利用adaptive阶段在未解决的问题上集中计算，并通过语义相关的成功响应作为上下文演示来重塑生成分布，实现比现有方法更好的性能同时消耗更少的推理计算。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时计算扩展方法存在两个局限性：(1)静态计算分配，无法动态调整；(2)从固定分布采样，无法适应具体查询特征。这导致计算资源无法高效利用，生成质量受限。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架：(1)Warm-up阶段——识别简单查询，从测试集本身组装初始问答对池；(2)Adaptive阶段——在未解决查询上集中计算，通过演化上下文演示（基于语义相似成功响应）重塑生成分布。
AI.result: 在数学、编程和推理基准测试中，方法持续优于基线，同时显著减少推理时计算消耗。
AI.conclusion: 通过动态分配计算资源并基于语义相关成功案例调整生成分布，可在降低计算成本的同时提升模型性能。

title: StructMem: Structured Memory for Long-Horizon Behavior in LLMs
summary: Long-term conversational agents need memory systems that capture relationships between events, not merely isolated facts, to support temporal reasoning and multi-hop question answering. Current approaches face a fundamental trade-off: flat memory is efficient but fails to model relational structure, while graph-based memory enables structured reasoning at the cost of expensive and fragile construction. To address these issues, we propose \textbf{StructMem}, a structure-enriched hierarchical memory framework that preserves event-level bindings and induces cross-event connections. By temporally anchoring dual perspectives and performing periodic semantic consolidation, StructMem improves temporal reasoning and multi-hop performance on \texttt{LoCoMo}, while substantially reducing token usage, API calls, and runtime compared to prior memory systems, see https://github.com/zjunlp/LightMem .

AI.tldr: StructMem通过结构增强的分层记忆框架解决了现有记忆系统效率与关系建模的权衡问题，采用时间锚定和语义整合机制，在提升推理能力的同时显著降低了计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆方法存在根本性权衡：扁平记忆高效但无法建模关系结构；图结构记忆支持结构化推理但构建成本高且脆弱。长期对话智能体需要能够捕捉事件间关系而非孤立事实的记忆系统，以支持时间推理和多跳问答。
AI.method: 提出StructMem，一种结构增强的分层记忆框架。通过时间锚定双重视角来保留事件级绑定，诱导跨事件连接，并执行周期性语义整合，从而在保持层次结构的同时建立事件间关系。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo基准上显著提升时间推理和多跳问答性能，同时大幅降低Token使用量、API调用次数和运行时间。GitHub: https://github.com/zjunlp/LightMem
AI.conclusion: StructMem成功解决了对话智能体记忆中效率与关系建模之间的权衡问题，在保持计算效率的同时实现了结构化推理能力。

title: Robust Test-time Video-Text Retrieval: Benchmarking and Adapting for Query Shifts
summary: Modern video-text retrieval (VTR) models excel on in-distribution benchmarks but are highly vulnerable to real-world query shifts, where the distribution of query data deviates from the training domain, leading to a sharp performance drop. Existing image-focused robustness solutions are inadequate to handle this vulnerability in video, as they fail to address the complex spatio-temporal dynamics inherent in these shifts. To systematically evaluate this vulnerability, we first introduce a comprehensive benchmark featuring 12 distinct types of video perturbations across five severity degrees. Analysis on this benchmark reveals that query shifts amplify the hubness phenomenon, where a few gallery items become dominant "hubs" that attract a disproportionate number of queries. To mitigate this, we then propose HAT-VTR (Hubness Alleviation for Test-time Video-Text Retrieval), as our baseline test-time adaptation framework designed to directly counteract hubness in VTR. It leverages two key components: a Hubness Suppression Memory to refine similarity scores, and multi-granular losses to enforce temporal feature consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HAT-VTR substantially improves robustness, consistently outperforming prior methods across diverse query shift scenarios, and enhancing model reliability for real-world applications.

AI.tldr: 本文针对现代视频-文本检索（VTR）模型在真实世界查询偏移场景下性能急剧下降的问题，提出系统性的基准测试和基于测试时自适应的解决方案HAT-VTR。
AI.motivation: 现有VTR模型在分布内基准测试表现优异，但在真实世界查询偏移场景下（查询数据分布偏离训练域）鲁棒性极差。现有图像领域的鲁棒性方法无法有效处理视频中复杂的时空动态变化，因此需要专门针对视频查询偏移的系统性评估和解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 构建综合基准测试：12种视频扰动类型 × 5个严重程度等级；2) 发现核心问题：查询偏移会显著放大"hubness现象"（少数gallery项目成为主导"hub"，吸引不成比例的查询）；3) 提出HAT-VTR框架（Hubness Alleviation for Test-time Video-Text Retrieval），包含两个关键组件：Hubness Suppression Memory（抑制hubness的记忆机制）和Multi-granular Losses（多粒度损失函数用于强制时序特征一致性）。
AI.result: HAT-VTR在多种查询偏移场景下均显著优于现有方法，有效提升了模型的鲁棒性和可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次系统性地揭示了VTR中查询偏移放大的hubness问题，并提出了有效的测试时自适应解决方案，为视频-文本检索模型在真实世界应用中的部署提供了重要支撑。

title: Learning AI Without a STEM Background: Mixed-Methods Evidence from a Diverse, Mixed-Cohort AIED Program
summary: Despite growing interest in AI education, most AIED initiatives remain narrowly targeted toward STEM-prepared students, limiting participation by non-STEM learners and adults seeking to engage with AI in public-interest, policy, or workforce contexts. This paper presents and evaluates an NSF-funded, innovative mixed-cohort AI education model that intentionally integrates non-STEM undergraduates and adult learners into a shared learning environment centered on ethical reasoning, socio-technical judgment, and applied AI literacy rather than technical proficiency alone. Drawing on mixed-methods data from course surveys, open-ended reflections, and educator reports, we examine learners' academic agency, confidence navigating AI concepts, critical engagement with ethical tradeoffs, and perceived expansion of postsecondary and career trajectories. Quantitative results indicate significant gains in confidence and perceived relevance of AI across cohorts' participants, while qualitative analyses reveal a consistent emphasis on responsibility, judgment, and contextual reasoning over technical mastery. Instructors and near-peer mentors corroborated high levels of engagement and productive challenge, particularly in dialogic and scenario-based learning activities. Our findings suggest that human-centered instructional supports, such as ethical scaffolding, mentorship, and structured discussion, are essential components of equitable AI education, especially in heterogeneous and non-traditional learner populations. We argue that ethical judgment should be treated as a core learning outcome in AIED alongside AI literacy, and we offer design implications for expanding access to AI education in policy-relevant and workforce-adjacent contexts.

AI.tldr: An evaluation of an NSF-funded mixed-cohort AI education model showing that integrating diverse learners (non-STEM students and adults) through ethical reasoning and human-centered instructional supports yields significant gains in AI confidence and engagement, suggesting ethical judgment should be a core learning outcome alongside technical AI literacy.
AI.motivation: Most AI education initiatives (AIED) are narrowly targeted toward STEM-prepared students, excluding non-STEM learners and adults who seek to engage with AI in public-interest, policy, or workforce contexts.
AI.method: Mixed-methods study using course surveys, open-ended reflections, and educator reports to evaluate an NSF-funded mixed-cohort AI education model that integrates non-STEM undergraduates and adult learners in a shared learning environment.
AI.result: Quantitative results: significant gains in confidence and perceived relevance of AI across cohorts. Qualitative results: consistent emphasis on responsibility, judgment, and contextual reasoning over technical mastery. Educators corroborated high engagement and productive challenge in dialogic and scenario-based learning activities.
AI.conclusion: 1) Human-centered instructional supports (ethical scaffolding, mentorship, structured discussion) are essential for equitable AI education, particularly in heterogeneous and non-traditional learner populations; 2) Ethical judgment should be treated as a core learning outcome in AIED alongside AI literacy; 3) Design implications are offered for expanding access to AI education in policy-relevant and workforce-adjacent contexts.

title: Assessing the Impact of Requirement Ambiguity on LLM-based Function-Level Code Generation
summary: Software requirement ambiguity is ubiquitous in real-world development, stemming from the inherent imprecision of natural language and the varying interpretations of stakeholders. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in generating code from precise specifications, such ambiguity poses a significant obstacle to reliable automated code generation. Existing benchmarks typically assume clear and unambiguous requirements, leaving an empirical gap in understanding how LLMs behave when faced with the inherent uncertainty of real-world software requirements. In this paper, we introduce Orchid, the first code generation benchmark specifically designed with ambiguous requirements. It comprises 1,304 function-level tasks covering four distinct types of ambiguity: lexical, syntactic, semantic, and vagueness. Leveraging this dataset, we conduct the first systematic empirical study to evaluate the impact of requirement ambiguity on LLM-based code generation. Our results demonstrate that ambiguity consistently degrades the performance of all evaluated LLMs, with the most pronounced negative effects observed in highly advanced models. Furthermore, we observe that LLMs frequently produce functionally divergent implementations for the same ambiguous requirement and lack the capability to identify or resolve such ambiguity autonomously. These findings reveal a significant performance gap between clear and ambiguous requirements, underscoring the urgent need for ambiguity-aware techniques in the next generation of automated software engineering tools. The Orchid benchmark is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/SII-YDD/Orchid.

AI.tldr: Orchid是首个专门针对模糊需求的代码生成基准测试，包含1,304个任务，涵盖词汇、句法、语义和模糊性四类歧义类型。研究发现需求歧义会一致性地降低所有LLM的代码生成性能，且高级模型受负面影响最大。
AI.motivation: 现实软件开发中，软件需求歧义普遍存在，源于自然语言的固有模糊性和利益相关者的不同理解。然而，现有基准测试通常假设需求清晰无歧义，无法评估LLM在面对真实世界需求不确定性时的表现，这形成了重要的实证研究空白。
AI.method: 构建Orchid基准测试，包含1,304个函数级代码生成任务，覆盖四类歧义：词汇歧义、句法歧义、语义歧义和模糊性。采用该数据集对多种LLM进行系统性实证评估。
AI.result: 研究表明：(1) 歧义一致性地降低所有被评估LLM的性能；(2) 高度先进的模型受到最显著的负面影响；(3) LLM经常为相同模糊需求生成功能不同的实现；(4) LLM缺乏自主识别或解决歧义的能力。
AI.conclusion: 清晰需求与模糊需求之间存在显著性能差距，揭示了下一代自动化软件工程工具迫切需要歧义感知技术。Orchid基准测试已在HuggingFace公开可用。

title: Systematizing Blockchain Research Themes and Design Patterns: Insights from the University Blockchain Research Initiative (UBRI)
summary: The rapid expansion of blockchain and digital asset ecosystems has intensified the challenge of translating academic research into deployable systems and regulatory frameworks. While advances in cryptography, consensus, digital assets, and governance are substantial, institutional mechanisms that sustain research-to-deployment translation at ecosystem scale remain comparatively under-theorized. This paper examines the architectural and coordination patterns that enable such translation, using the University Blockchain Research Initiative (UBRI) network as a representative case of long-term academic and industry collaboration. Drawing on research outputs and convenings from 2022 to 2025, we synthesize recurring design tensions across technical and institutional domains, including scalability versus security, decentralization versus governance, and privacy versus compliance. Rather than cataloging individual projects, we abstract system-level themes that connect research contributions to deployment constraints and policy adaptation, providing a structured lens for understanding how academic research informs production architectures, regulatory development, and ecosystem resilience in emerging decentralized infrastructures.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇综述性论文，以Ripple发起的大学区块链研究计划（UBRI）网络为代表性案例，系统提炼2022–2025年间学术界与产业界在区块链研究向部署转化过程中反复出现的系统级"设计张力"（可扩展性vs安全性、去中心化vs治理、隐私vs合规、自动化vs问责、创新vs监管），并归纳出连接研究贡献、生产架构与监管适应的结构化分析框架；作者并非逐项罗列项目，而是抽象出可迁移的制度性模式，用以解释学术独立性、产业投入与生态系统韧性如何长期共存。
AI.motivation: 区块链与数字资产生态快速扩张，密码学、共识、数字资产、治理等研究进展显著，但"支撑研究—部署转化在生态尺度上持续运转的制度机制"仍缺乏理论化（under-theorized）。学界研究往往难以嵌入生产系统与监管框架而不损害去中心化、安全或制度合法性。本文试图回答：什么样的架构与协调模式能够长期承载这种转化？选择UBRI作为长期产学合作的可观察案例，是因为它横跨工程、商业、法律与政策，规模大、时间跨度长、产出可核验（60+学术伙伴、1400+项目、1200+同行评审论文、800+课程修订），且有固定的会聚机制与年度亮点报告可供结构化梳理。作者亦明确声明该分析为"示例性制度案例"而非穷尽性全球测绘，并声明与Ripple的利益关联。
AI.method: 采用主题—设计模式（theme-based design-pattern）文献综合方法，素材来自2022–2025年UBRI网络支持的研究成果、会议与年度亮点报告。分析步骤为：(1) 不按项目或机构罗列，而按"反复出现的结构性设计张力"重组文献；(2) 每个张力先给出支配性约束（governing constraint），再归类代表性工作并附引用；(3) 覆盖数字货币与代币化、敌对协调下的安全、共识与治理及市场协调、隐私与零知识、互操作与扩展性、可持续性与社会影响、法律与监管适应、制度设计与计算范式八个主题域；(4) 在第3节转向生态外延，分析制度与政策桥接机制、创新激励与开发者管线、体验式学习与能力形成三个层次的制度架构；(5) 第4节提出开放问题。全篇为定性系统化综述/经验案例分析，无定量实验、无对照组的实证设计，亦未采用系统综述的检索式、纳入排除标准或PRISMA流程，故证据强度依赖引用文献本身。
AI.result: （1）核心技术域：数字货币/代币化受制于"合规嵌入"而非技术可行性——选择性披露、CBDC隐私分级、稳定币制裁与KYC与保密性并存、DeFi安全约束符号化分析、跨链互操作韧性—脆弱性权衡、链下模拟评估、链上强制执行的数字抵押品扩展信贷；数字抵押品扩展信贷。安全被界定为对抗条件下的协调问题，关键在"排序权/审查权的分配"（MEV缓解、区块生产行为形式化分析），并强调检测（漏洞、预言机、LLM代码审计）、适应性（勒索软件等密码化犯罪中以链上透明性反制）与治理响应（DAO激励、human-in-the-loop 在安全与活性间权衡）三者耦合。共识侧：PoS博弈均衡、FBA拓扑与鲁棒性、gossip层评估、模糊测试与受控基准。隐私侧：ZK 证明、图匿名凭证、选择性披露、SNARK兼容可验证加密、分区式隐私扩展，边界是"正确性可公开验证而数据保持隐藏"。扩展性侧：乐观Rollup与支付通道并非消除验证，而是"有条件继承"安全性于欺诈证明、争议窗口与结算假设。（2）制度与生态层：研究者—部署转化的稳定性取决于治理中介（常设会议系列、选址作为召集战略、顾问委员会在广度与深度间的平衡）、创新加速（竞赛/黑客松/加速器在深度与扩散间取舍；股权制与非股权资助在长期激励与学术中立间取舍；平台专属计划利于深度但抑制跨平台实验；UBRI Research Corpus 降低发现成本）与能力形成（黑客松 vs 多周驻留；XRPL Student Builder Residency 两期数据：规模12→17人，开发技能+87%/+49%，通用区块链知识+117%/+62%，XRPL专项知识+219%/+153%，新手队列在通用与专项维度增益更高）三者"共同配置"而非孤立干预。（3）学术中立被论证为可持续多利益方参与的结构性条件，而非与实践隔离。
AI.conclusion: 结论认为研究—部署转化的贡献不在任何单项创新，而在于展示了制度设计如何中介理论探究与真实部署：持续资助结构、常设会聚机制、研究发现基础设施与跨部门顾问流程能够在不将学术独立性完全让位于产业诉求的前提下稳定这一转化层。跨技术域的设计张力（可扩展性与去中心化权衡、隐私与合规协商、治理自动化带来问责难题、跨链互操作引发管辖与制度对齐问题）并非孤立技术问题，而是决定研究能否迁移为可部署基础设施的系统级协调约束；未来研究应聚焦纵向实证证据（长期采纳动态、用户行为、治理绩效、制度适应）、其他研究联盟/产业主导计划/监管环境的比较分析，以及激励演化、混合型去中心化—监管治理的长期适应与法律制度对系统结果的实际塑造作用。作者定位该工作为"为去中心化基础设施制度成熟提供结构化基础"的框架而非对领域的定界。

title: Validating a Deep Learning Algorithm to Identify Patients with Glaucoma using Systemic Electronic Health Records
summary: We evaluated whether a glaucoma risk assessment (GRA) model trained on All of Us national data can identify patients at high probability of glaucoma using only systemic electronic health records (EHR) at an independent institution. In this cross-sectional study, 20,636 Stanford patients seen from November 2013 to January 2024 were included (15% with glaucoma). A pretrained GRA model was fine-tuned on the Stanford cohort and tested on a held-out set using demographics, systemic diagnoses, medications, laboratory results, and physical examination measurements as inputs. The best model achieved AUROC 0.883 and PPV 0.657. Calibration was consistent with clinical risk: the highest prediction decile showed the greatest glaucoma diagnosis rate (65.7%) and treatment rate (57.0%). Performance improved with more trainable layers up to 15 and with additional data. An EHR-only GRA model may enable scalable and accessible pre-screening without specialized imaging.

AI.tldr: 本研究验证了仅基于系统性电子健康记录训练的青光眼风险评估模型在独立机构的有效性，最优模型AUROC达0.883，表明EHR数据可用于可扩展的青光眼初筛。
AI.motivation: 探索能否利用全国性数据训练的青光眼风险评估模型，仅通过系统性电子健康记录（EHR）数据在独立机构中识别高概率青光眼患者。
AI.method: 横断面研究，纳入20,636例斯坦福患者（15%患有青光眼）。使用 demographics、系统性诊断、药物、实验室结果和体检指标作为输入，对预训练的GRA模型在斯坦福队列上进行微调，并在保留测试集上评估。
AI.result: 最优模型达到AUROC 0.883，PPV 0.657。校准结果与临床风险一致：最高预测分位数显示青光眼诊断率（65.7%）和治疗率（57.0%）最高。可训练层数增加到15层时性能提升，且随数据量增加而改善。
AI.conclusion: 仅使用系统性电子健康记录（EHR）的青光眼风险评估模型可能实现无需专业影像设备的可扩展、可及的青光眼初筛。

authors: Ibrahim Abdulmalik Hassan Muneef Y. Alshawsh
title: Machine learning and digital pragmatics: Which word category influences emoji use most?
summary: This study investigates Machine Learning (ML) in the prediction of emojis in Arabic tweets employing the (state-of-the-art) MARBERT model. A corpus of 11379 CA tweets representing multiple Arabic colloquial dialects was collected from X.com via Python. A net dataset includes 8695 tweets, which were utilized for the analysis. These tweets were then classified into 14 categories, which were numerically encoded and used as labels. A preprocessing pipeline was designed as an interpretable baseline, allowing us to examine the relationship between lexical features and emoji categories. MARBERT was finetuned to predict emoji use from textual input. We evaluated the model performance in terms of precision, recall and F1-scores. Findings reveal that the model performed quite well with an overall accuracy 0.75. The study concludes that although the findings are promising, there is still a need for improving machine learning models including MARBERT, specifically for low-resource and multidialectal languages like Arabic.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用MARBERT模型对阿拉伯语方言推文进行表情符号预测，基于8695条推文数据构建14类分类任务，模型准确率达75%，证明预训练语言模型对阿拉伯语表情预测有效，但仍需进一步优化以应对阿拉伯语低资源和多方言的挑战。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语是一种低资源且多方言的语言，现有机器学习模型对其处理能力有限，需要探索如何利用先进的预训练模型（如MARBERT）来改善阿拉伯语推文中表情符号的预测效果。
AI.method: 收集了11379条阿拉伯语推文（最终使用8695条），建立14类分类标签体系，设计预处理流程作为可解释基线以分析词汇特征与表情类别的关系，使用MARBERT模型进行微调预测，并通过精确率、召回率和F1分数评估模型性能。
AI.result: MARBERT模型在14类表情预测任务中达到75%的整体准确率，表明该模型在阿拉伯语表情预测任务上具有较好的性能。
AI.conclusion: MARBERT模型在阿拉伯语推文表情预测任务上取得了75%的准确率，结果具有潜力，但仍需改进机器学习模型以应对阿拉伯语这类低资源和多方言语言的特点。

title: HypEHR: Hyperbolic Modeling of Electronic Health Records for Efficient Question Answering
summary: Electronic health record (EHR) question answering is often handled by LLM-based pipelines that are costly to deploy and do not explicitly leverage the hierarchical structure of clinical data. Motivated by evidence that medical ontologies and patient trajectories exhibit hyperbolic geometry, we propose HypEHR, a compact Lorentzian model that embeds codes, visits, and questions in hyperbolic space and answers queries via geometry-consistent cross-attention with type-specific pointer heads. HypEHR is pretrained with next-visit diagnosis prediction and hierarchy-aware regularization to align representations with the ICD ontology. On two MIMIC-IV-based EHR-QA benchmarks, HypEHR approaches LLM-based methods while using far fewer parameters. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/yuyuliu11037/HypEHR.

AI.tldr: HypEHR是一个紧凑的Lorentzian模型，利用双曲几何嵌入医疗代码、就诊和问题，在ICD本体对齐的预训练下，以显著更少的参数达到与LLM方法相当的EHR问答性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的EHR问答流程成本高昂，且未显式利用临床数据的层次结构。医学本体和患者轨迹存在双曲几何特征，为解决此问题提供了理论基础。
AI.method: HypEHR采用Lorentzian模型，将医疗代码、就诊记录和问题嵌入双曲空间，通过类型特定指针头实现几何一致的跨注意力机制。预训练任务包括下一就诊诊断预测和层次感知正则化以对齐ICD本体表示。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV两个EHR-QA基准数据集上，HypEHR性能接近LLM方法，但参数规模远小于后者。
AI.conclusion: HypEHR provides a parameter-efficient alternative to LLM-based EHR-QA systems by leveraging hyperbolic geometry to capture the hierarchical structure of clinical data.

title: Learning to Communicate: Toward End-to-End Optimization of Multi-Agent Language Systems
summary: Multi-agent systems built on large language models have shown strong performance on complex reasoning tasks, yet most work focuses on agent roles and orchestration while treating inter-agent communication as a fixed interface. Latent communication through internal representations such as key-value caches offers a promising alternative to text-based protocols, but existing approaches do not jointly optimize communication with multi-agent reasoning. Therefore we propose DiffMAS, a training framework that treats latent communication as a learnable component of multi-agent systems. DiffMAS performs parameter-efficient supervised training over multi-agent latent trajectories, enabling agents to jointly learn how information should be encoded and interpreted across interactions. Experiments on mathematical reasoning, scientific QA, code generation, and commonsense benchmarks show that DiffMAS consistently improves reasoning accuracy and decoding stability over single-agent inference, text-based multi-agent systems, and prior latent communication methods, achieving 26.7% on AIME24, 20.2% on GPQA-Diamond, and consistent gains across reasoning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: DiffMAS是一个将潜在通信作为多智能体系统可学习组件的训练框架，通过参数高效监督学习实现智能体间信息编码与解释的联合优化，在数学推理、科学问答、代码生成和常识推理等多项基准上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体系统大多关注智能体角色和编排，而将智能体间通信视为固定接口。潜在通信（如通过键值缓存的内部表示）虽具前景，但现有方法未能将通信与多智能体推理联合优化。
AI.method: DiffMAS采用参数高效监督训练，在多智能体潜在轨迹上进行训练，使智能体能够联合学习信息在交互过程中如何编码和解释。方法核心是将潜在通信本身作为可学习组件，而非固定接口。
AI.result: DiffMAS在AIME24上达到26.7%，GPQA-Diamond上达到20.2%，并在多个推理基准上相比单智能体推理、基于文本的多智能体系统和先前潜在通信方法均获得一致提升，同时解码稳定性也有所改善。
AI.conclusion: 通过将潜在通信纳入端到端学习框架，DiffMAS成功实现了通信机制与多智能体推理的联合优化，为提升LLM多智能体系统的推理能力提供了有效途径。

title: DenoiseRank: Learning to Rank by Diffusion Models
summary: Learning to rank (LTR) is one of the core tasks in Machine Learning. Traditional LTR models have made great progress, but nearly all of them are implemented from discriminative perspective. In this paper, we aim at addressing LTR from a novel perspective, i.e., by a deep generative model. Specifically, we propose a novel denoise rank model, DenoiseRank, which noises the relevant labels in the diffusion process and denoises them on the query documents in the reverse process to accurately predict their distribution. Our model is the first to address traditional LTR from generative perspective and is a diffusion method for LTR. Our extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrated the effectiveness of DenoiseRank, and we believe it provides a benchmark for generative LTR task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DenoiseRank，首个从生成视角解决排序问题的深度扩散模型，通过对相关标签加噪并在反向过程中去噪来预测文档分布，在基准数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统的Learning to Rank (LTR)模型均从判别视角出发，尚未有生成式方法解决排序任务。作者希望探索一种全新的生成式排序范式。
AI.method: 提出DenoiseRank模型，采用扩散模型框架：1) 在前向扩散过程中对相关标签添加噪声；2) 在反向去噪过程中对查询-文档进行去噪，从而准确预测其分布。
AI.result: DenoiseRank作为首个生成式LTR方法和首个LTR扩散模型，在多个基准数据集上进行了广泛实验，验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 生成式排序方法是可行的，DenoiseRank为生成式LTR任务提供了基准，为排序学习开辟了新的研究方向。

title: M-CARE: Standardized Clinical Case Reporting for AI Model Behavioral Disorders, with a 20-Case Atlas and Experimental Validation
comment: 31 pages, 5 figures, 14 tables. Second paper in the Model Medicine series (Paper #1: arXiv:2603.04722)
summary:
We introduce M-CARE (Model Clinical Assessment and Reporting for Evaluation), a clinical case report framework for AI model behavioral disorders adapted from human medicine. M-CARE provides a 13-section report format, a 4-axis diagnostic assessment system, and a nosological classification of AI behavioral conditions.
  We present 20 cases from three source categories: field observations of deployed agents (8), controlled experiments across three platforms (8), and published sources (4). Cases are organized into five categories: RLHF Performance Artifacts, Shell-Core Override Pathology, Context & Memory Conditions, Core Identity & Plasticity, and Stress, Methodology, & Boundary Conditions.
  As a featured case, we present Shell-Induced Behavioral Override (SIBO) -- a controlled experiment showing that Shell instructions categorically override a model's default cooperative behavior. SIBO was validated across five game domains (Trust Game, Poker, Avalon, Codenames, Chess), revealing a domain-dependent spectrum (SIBO Index: 0.75 to 0.10) that varies with action space complexity, Core domain expertise, and temporal directness.
  M-CARE is extensible: new cases and categories integrate without framework modification. We release the framework, all 20 case reports, and experimental data as open resources.

AI.tldr: M-CARE是一项将临床医学病例报告方法论创新性应用于AI模型行为评估的开创性工作，通过13-section报告格式和4轴诊断系统实现AI行为障碍的标准化分类，并通过对20个病例的系统分析揭示了Shell指令对模型行为的影响规律（SIBO现象），为AI行为诊断提供了可扩展的开放资源框架。
AI.motivation: 当前AI系统在人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）训练后可能表现出行为异常，但缺乏系统性的诊断和分类方法。现有评估框架未能充分捕捉AI模型特有的行为障碍模式，亟需一套类似人类医学的标准化临床病例报告体系。
AI.method: 研究团队构建了包含13个报告章节、4轴诊断评估系统及AI行为条件分类学的标准化框架，并基于三个来源（部署智能体现场观察8例、跨三个平台对照实验8例、已发表文献4例）展示了20个病例，归纳为五类：RLHF性能伪影、Shell-核心覆盖病理学、上下文与记忆条件、核心身份与可塑性、压力方法论与边界条件。其中SIBO（Shell诱导行为覆盖）作为特色病例，通过五个游戏领域（信任游戏、德州扑克、阿瓦隆、行动代号、国际象棋）进行跨领域对照实验验证。
AI.result: 实验验证了Shell指令能够系统性覆盖模型的默认合作行为，且揭示了领域依赖性差异（SIBO指数从0.75至0.10不等），该差异与动作空间复杂度、核心领域专业知识及时间直接性相关联。
AI.conclusion: M-CARE框架具有可扩展性，可通过开放资源形式发布，支持新案例和类别的集成而无需修改框架本身。研究团队公开了框架、全部20份病例报告及实验数据。

title: SpecSyn: LLM-based Synthesis and Refinement of Formal Specifications for Real-world Program Verification
summary: Program verification is a formal technique to rigorously ensure the correctness and fault-freeness of software systems. However, constructing comprehensive interprocedural specifications for full verification obligations is time-consuming and labor-intensive, giving rise to automated specification generation approaches. Despite the significant advancements in these approaches brought by Large Language Models (LLMs), existing LLM-empowered approaches still suffer from significant limitations: they lack effective strategies for handling sizable input programs, and are typically equipped with no mechanisms to evaluate and guarantee the strength of the generated specifications. The limitations impair their ability to extract precise specifications from real-world complicated programs to support the verification of target properties, thereby hindering the applicability of existing approaches in verification tasks on real-world programs. To remedy this gap, we propose SpecSyn, a novel LLM-based specification generation method. SpecSyn first decomposes the input program into individual segments, which are handled respectively by the subsequent iterative specification generation process. Innovatively, we incorporate into the process a specification refinement mechanism based on semantic-non-equivalent program mutations and variant discrimination, assessing and enhancing the semantic strength of the generated specifications. Extensive experiments show that SpecSyn maintains high precision over 90% and outstanding recall over 75%, significantly outperforming existing LLM-based approaches. In further evaluations, SpecSyn successfully handles 1071 out of 1365 target properties for open-source programs, proving its applicability on real-world program verification tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpecSyn，一种基于大语言模型的程序规格自动生成方法。通过程序分解和基于语义不等价变异的规格细化机制，解决现有方法在处理大型程序和保证规格语义强度方面的不足，在实验中表现优异并在实际开源项目中验证了其可用性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的规格生成方法存在两大局限：缺乏处理大型程序的有效策略，以及缺乏评估和保证生成规格强度的机制。这些局限导致难以从真实复杂程序中提取精确规格来支持目标属性验证。
AI.method: SpecSyn采用程序分解策略，将大型输入程序拆分为多个段分别处理，并结合基于语义不等价程序变异的规格细化机制，通过变体判别评估和增强生成规格的语义强度，采用迭代式规格生成流程。
AI.result: 精确度超过90%，召回率超过75%，显著优于现有LLM方法；在开源项目上成功处理1365个目标属性中的1071个。
AI.conclusion: SpecSyn significantly outperforms existing LLM-based approaches, achieving high precision (>90%) and outstanding recall (>75%), and successfully handles 1071 out of 1365 target properties in real-world program verification tasks.

title: Leveraging SIMD for Accelerating Large-number Arithmetic
summary: Large-number arithmetic, widely used in scientific computing and cryptography, has seen limited adoption of single instruction, multiple data (SIMD) parallelism on modern CPUs due to the inherent dependencies in traditional algorithms. We present DigitsOnTurbo (DoT), which restructures the computation around independent, data-parallel operations, rather than vectorizing the standard algorithms, thereby leveraging the benefits provided by SIMD. Over prior SIMD implementations, DoT achieves up to 1.85x speedups for addition and subtraction, and 2.3x for multiplication. When integrated into state-of-the-art libraries, DoT yields up to 4x speedup for addition and subtraction, and up to 2x speedup for multiplication, cascading into end-to-end throughput gains of up to 19.3% for scientific computations, and up to 7.9% latency and 5.9% throughput improvements on cryptographic implementations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DigitsOnTurbo(DoT)框架，通过将大数运算的计算结构重构为独立的并行操作来充分利用SIMD能力，相比之前SIMD实现，在加减法上实现1.85倍、乘法上实现2.3倍的加速，集成到现有库后性能提升更为显著。
AI.motivation: 传统大数算术算法存在内在依赖性，限制了SIMD并行在现代CPU上的应用
AI.method: 将大数运算计算重构为基于独立、数据并行操作的架构，而非简单向量化传统算法
AI.result: 相比原有SIMD实现，加减法提升1.85倍，乘法提升2.3倍；集成到先进库后加减法提升4倍，乘法提升2倍；科学计算吞吐量提升19.3%，密码学延迟改善7.9%，吞吐量提升5.9%
AI.conclusion: 通过将计算重构为独立的数据并行操作而非向量化传统算法，成功突破了大数运算中SIMD并行的瓶颈。实验结果表明该方法在多种场景下均取得显著性能提升。

title: ILDR: Geometric Early Detection of Grokking
summary: Grokking describes a delayed generalization phenomenon in which a neural network achieves perfect training accuracy long before validation accuracy improves, followed by an abrupt transition to strong generalization. Existing detection signals are indirect: weight norm reflects parameter-space regularization and consistently lags the transition, while GrokFast's slow gradient EMA, used without gradient amplification, is unstable across seeds with standard deviation exceeding mean lead time. We propose the Inter/Intra-class Distance Ratio (ILDR), a geometric metric computed on second-to-last layer representations as the ratio of inter-class centroid separation to intra-class scatter. ILDR provides an early detection signal: it rises and crosses a threshold at 2.5 times its baseline before the grokking transition appears in validation accuracy, indicating early geometric reorganization in representation space. Grounded in Fisher's linear discriminant criterion, ILDR requires no eigendecomposition and runs in O(|C|^2 + N). It is evaluated exclusively on held-out data, making it robust to memorization effects. Across modular arithmetic and permutation group composition (S5), ILDR leads the grokking transition by 9 to 73 percent of the training budget, with lead time increasing with task algebraic complexity. Over eight random seeds, ILDR leads by 950 +/- 250 steps with a coefficient of variation of 26 percent, and post-grokking variance drops by 1696 times, consistent with a sharp phase transition in representation space. Using ILDR as an early stopping trigger reduces training by 18.6 percent on average. Optimizer interventions triggered at the ILDR threshold demonstrate bidirectional control over the transition, suggesting ILDR tracks representational conditions underlying generalization rather than a downstream correlate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Inter/Intra-class Distance Ratio (ILDR)——一种基于网络倒数第二层表征的类间质心距离与类内散布之比的几何指标，可在 grokking（顿悟）泛化跃迁之前提供早期预警信号。该指标受 Fisher 线性判别准则启发，无需特征分解，计算复杂度为 O(|C|²+N)，仅在留出数据上评估以规避记忆效应。在模运算与 S5 置换群任务上，ILDR 提前 9%–73% 训练预算（平均领先 950±250 步，变异系数 26%）检测到跃迁，post-grokking 方差降低 1696 倍；以 ILDR 作为早停触发可平均节省 18.6% 训练量，并支持对过渡的双向优化器干预。
AI.motivation: Grokking 现象中，模型在训练精度早已达到 100% 之后，验证精度才突然跃升，形成延迟泛化的相变。已有检测信号均为间接代理：权重范数反映的是参数空间正则化，其变化始终滞后于验证精度跃迁；GrokFast 的慢速梯度 EMA（未做梯度放大时）在不同随机种子间不稳定，标准差甚至超过其平均提前量。因此需要一种既精确又稳定、能够刻画跃迁前表征空间重组过程的早期检测信号，同时该信号不应受模型记忆训练样本的干扰。
AI.method: 核心方法是在倒数第二层隐藏表征上定义几何度量 ILDR = 类间质心分离度 / 类内散布度。理论依据为 Fisher 线性判别准则：只要类间分离相对类内离散足够大，线性判别方向即可区分类别；因此 ILDR 的上升可作为表征已具备可分性、即将发生 grokking 跃迁的判据。实现上无需对特征协方差做特征分解，只需类质心与类内散布的二次型计算，复杂度 O(|C|²+N)（|C| 为类别数，N 为样本数），计算开销可忽略。该度量完全在留出（held-out）数据上计算，不依赖训练轨迹或梯度，因此对记忆化效应鲁棒。实验在模运算（modular arithmetic）与 S5 置换群复合两类 grokking 基准任务上进行，覆盖 8 个随机种子；评估内容包括相对 grokking 跃迁的领先步数与相对训练预算比例、跃迁前后表征方差、以 ILDR 阈值为触发的早停策略的算力节省，以及在阈值处施加不同强度的优化器干预（如权重衰减/学习率调整）以检验对过渡的双向可控性。
AI.result: 1) 早期检测：ILDR 在基线的 2.5 倍处越过阈值时，验证精度尚未出现 grokking 跃迁，说明表征空间的重构在泛化跃迁之前即已开始。2) 提前量：在模运算与 S5 任务上，ILDR 领先 grokking 跃迁 9%–73% 的训练预算，且领先幅度随任务代数复杂度（S5 高于模运算）而增大，表明复杂度越高、几何重组越早。3) 稳定性：8 个随机种子下领先 950±250 步，变异系数仅 26%，相较之下 GrokFast 慢速梯度 EMA 的标准差超过其均值，提前量本身不可靠。4) 相变证据：post-grokking 阶段的方差下降 1696 倍，与表征空间中尖锐相变的行为一致。5) 实用性：以 ILDR 阈值作为早停触发器，平均减少 18.6% 的训练开销，且节省比例在复杂任务上更明显。6) 因果性：在 ILDR 阈值处施加优化器干预可双向控制过渡（既可加速也可抑制/延缓 grokking），说明 ILDR 不只是泛化的下游相关物，而确实追踪了泛化所依赖的表征条件。
AI.conclusion: ILDR 是一个几何、免训练轨迹依赖、计算开销低且跨种子稳定的 grokking 早期检测与控制指标。相比权重范数与梯度 EMA 等间接信号，它能以约 950 步（26% CV）的稳定提前量捕捉表征空间的相变前重组，随任务代数复杂度增强而更为可靠，并为训练预算节省（平均 18.6%）与跃迁的双向干预提供了实用触发器。其局限在于：结论主要基于模运算与置换群这类合成的 grokking 基准，尚未在更大规模的语言/视觉 grokking 场景中验证；指标需要类别标签与留出数据，适用场景限于有明确类别结构的分类式任务；对"阈值 2.5 倍基线"的普适性仍需更多任务与超参标定支持。

title: GRISP: Guided Recurrent IRI Selection over SPARQL Skeletons
summary: We present GRISP (Guided Recurrent IRI Selection over SPARQL Skeletons), a novel SPARQL-based question-answering method over knowledge graphs based on fine-tuning a small language model (SLM). Given a natural-language question, the method first uses the SLM to generate a natural-language SPARQL query skeleton, and then to re-rank and select knowledge graph items to iteratively replace the natural-language placeholders using knowledge graph constraints. The SLM is jointly trained on skeleton generation and list-wise re-ranking data generated from standard question-query pairs. We evaluate the method on common Wikidata and Freebase benchmarks, and achieve better results than other state-of-the-art methods in a comparable setting.

AI.tldr: GRISP 是一种基于 SPARQL 的知识图谱问答（KGQA）方法：先微调小语言模型（Qwen2.5 7B）生成自然语言占位符化的 SPARQL 骨架，再通过带回溯搜索的“检索-重排序”流程在知识图谱约束下逐个把占位符解析为具体 IRI，必要时校验最终查询；在 Freebase/Wikidata 基准上超过 ChatKBQA 与 WikiSP，且比智能体式零样本方法（如 GRASP+GPT-4.1）快一个数量级，可在单张消费级 GPU 上运行。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱问答（KGQA）现有两条路线：一是基于语义解析将自然语言问题翻译为 SPARQL 查询，二是智能体式零样本方法（如 GRASP、SPINACH）由大模型自主与 KG 交互探索。前者（如 ChatKBQA、WikiSP）通常依赖人工设计的、针对特定 KG 和基准的机制（Freebase 专用的 FACC1 提及、按基准调优的 S 表达式解析器、Wikidata 搜索 API），泛化性差且实体/属性解析多为一次性查找、无法纠错；后者依赖昂贵的大模型、延迟高（每题数十秒）、无法利用问题-查询对训练数据，且对硬件要求高。作者的观察是：SLM 在 IRI 已知或被替换为自然语言占位符时能可靠完成语义解析，因此可以先让 SLM 生成骨架，再由 KG 约束下的迭代解析来弥补 SLM 缺乏 KG 知识的短板，从而在保持速度与低硬件门槛的同时取得比微调方法更优的效果。
AI.method:
两阶段 generate-then-retrieve 设计。
阶段一（骨架生成）：用 LoRA 微调的 Qwen2.5 7B（r=32, α=32，全部线性层，4 epoch，lr 1e-4，warmup+cosine，batch 8，早停）做束搜索（beam width 8，temperature 0.4，top-p 0.9，带采样）生成多个 SPARQL 骨架，其中所有 IRI 被替换为自然语言占位符 PH:"..."；去重、过滤无法解析的输出，保留 top-3 进入阶段二。
阶段二（占位符解析，本文核心创新）：自左向右逐个解析占位符，视为解析树的深度优先搜索。每个占位符处做检索-重排序：按占位符在查询中的语法位置检索实体索引或属性索引（位置推断失败如 FILTER 中则同时检索两个索引），取 top-10 候选，由同一 SLM 以 list-wise 方式单次前向重排序（为每个候选分配单 token 标识符，按 logit 排序，类似 FIRST），并始终加入 None 选项；排序高于 None 的候选压入栈以备回溯，低于 None 的丢弃；栈顶候选替换占位符。
KG 引导与约束：从已解析前缀导出单列 SPARQL 查询（如 SELECT DISTINCT ?p WHERE { wd:Q104123 ?p ?d }），执行后把索引检索限制在返回的 IRI 集合内，从而只搜索该实体实际关联的属性；占位符位于 UNION 等高级构造时跳过约束检索。
回溯：若 None 被排到首位或约束检索无候选，则回到上一个占位符、丢弃导致死路的选项并对其栈中剩余候选重新重排序（不沿用原顺序，因训练仅监督首位）。
校验与输出：全部解析后执行 SPARQL，要求可解析、可执行且结果非空，否则回溯一步；某骨架搜索树耗尽则换下一个骨架，返回首个有效结果。
训练数据：骨架生成样本由问题-查询对替换 IRI 为其主标签或别名（Wikidata 为 rdfs:label / skos:altLabel）；重排序样本随机选一个 IRI 并把其后所有 IRI 转为占位符，用其标签检索候选，施加四种增强：随机化 top-k、随机丢弃歧义元数据（如 schema:description）、随机丢弃正确候选以学习选 None、随机打乱候选以消除位置偏置；每 epoch 重新生成数据（可离线预计算以提速）。联合训练损失为骨架生成的 next-token 交叉熵 + 重排序限制在候选标识符 token 上的交叉熵（因仅有单一目标候选，故不用 FIRST 的排序损失）。
实现上 KG 无关，仅需按 KG 配置标签/别名/元数据等索引属性。
AI.result: Freebase：CWQ F1 75.1（ChatKBQA 70.3），WQSP 76.0（ChatKBQA 74.0）。Wikidata：QALD-7 47.8（WikiSP 43.6），WWQ 79.5（WikiSP 71.9），WWQ dev 85.3（WikiSP 76.5），WDQL 57.6（基线 16.0）。其他：QALD-10 F1 47.6/EM 46.9，LC-QuAD 2.0 F1 74.2，SimpleQuestions F1 90.8，QAWiki F1 47.3。平均每题耗时 2.3s–14s（单张 RTX 4090 24GB）。与 GRASP 对比（共同样本）：GRISP 7B 在 CWQ 77.0、WQSP 73.3、WWQ 78.8，远高于 GRASP GPT-4.1 的 44.5/52.3/75.3；但在训练数据稀少的 QALD-7（46.7 vs 79.8）、QALD-10（44.5 vs 72.7）和 SPINACH（29.3 vs 40.8）上落后于智能体方法。超参研究：束宽 8 与 top-k 10 之后收益递减；模型规模 0.5B/1.5B/3B/7B 的 F1 为 74.8/80.8/81.6/85.3。消融（WWQ dev，默认 84.4）：去除重排序降幅最大（78.6），其后为束搜索（79.0）、KG 引导（80.7）、约束检索（83.2）、回溯（83.9）；全关闭仅 70.4，仅重排序 79.1。训练设置中联合训练（84.4）优于分开训练（82.2）与仅骨架训练（75.9/75.8）。诊断：oracle 骨架 F1 在 WWQ dev 为 98.6（骨架生成损失 14.2 点、解析损失 1.4 点），QALD-10 为 94.6（骨架损失 48.1 点、解析损失 5.4 点）；回溯频率 WWQ dev 平均 0.39 次/样本（35/454 样本发生），QALD-10 升至 2.70 次/样本（125/394 样本）。
AI.conclusion: GRISP 通过“生成骨架 + 受 KG 约束的带回溯检索重排序解析”这一占位符解析阶段，在同等设置下超越 ChatKBQA 与 WikiSP 等微调型 SOTA，并显著快于智能体零样本方法；消融证明占位符解析阶段（尤其是重排序与 KG 引导）是其优势来源。其主要局限是依赖问题-查询对，训练数据不足或查询更复杂多样时（QALD-7/10、SPINACH）落后于智能体方法，且此时骨架生成成为主要瓶颈；所有结果仅单次训练运行，且在 UNION 等高级 SPARQL 构造中未启用约束检索。论文开源了代码（GRASP 仓库）、模型权重、基准与预测。未来方向包括对结果做合理性检查（如“All British Monarchs”应含伊丽莎白二世）并在必要时扩充骨架池，作者指出这在小模型上尚不明确如何实现。

title: Who Defines Fairness? Target-Based Prompting for Demographic Representation in Generative Models
summary: Text-to-image(T2I) models like Stable Diffusion and DALL-E have made generative AI widely accessible, yet recent studies reveal that these systems often replicate societal biases, particularly in how they depict demographic groups across professions. Prompts such as 'doctor' or 'CEO' frequently yield lighter-skinned outputs, while lower-status roles like 'janitor' show more diversity, reinforcing stereotypes. Existing mitigation methods typically require retraining or curated datasets, making them inaccessible to most users. We propose a lightweight, inference-time framework that mitigates representational bias through prompt-level intervention without modifying the underlying model. Instead of assuming a single definition of fairness, our approach allows users to select among multiple fairness specifications-ranging from simple choices such as a uniform distribution to more complex definitions informed by a large language model(LLM) that cites sources and provides confidence estimates. These distributions guide the construction of demographic specific prompt variants in the corresponding proportions, and we evaluate alignment by auditing adherence to the declared target and measuring the resulting skin tone distribution rather than assuming uniformity as 'fairness'. Across 36 prompts spanning 30 occupations and 6 non-occupational contexts, our method shifts observed skin-tone outcomes in directions consistent with the declared target, and reduces deviation from targets when the target is defined directly in skin-tone space(fallback). This work demonstrates how fairness interventions can be made transparent, controllable, and usable at inference time, directly empowering users of generative AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个轻量级、推理期（inference-time）的"目标导向提示"（target-based prompting）框架，用于缓解文本到图像（T2I）模型在职业与抽象语境中再现的肤色/人口表征偏见。其核心主张是：公平没有唯一标准，因此不应把"均匀分布"当作唯一公平定义，而应让用户显式声明一个代表性目标（可由 LLM 基于检索到的统计与来源给出比例与置信度，也可由用户自定义），再通过按目标比例生成人口子群提示变体来引导生成，并审计生成结果与"已声明目标"的对齐度。
AI.motivation:
1) 现状：Stable Diffusion、DALL·E 等 T2I 模型在职业提示上复现并放大社会刻板印象——高地位职业（doctor、CEO、lawyer）输出中 Fitzpatrick II 型占比约 69%，V–VI 型合计不足 2%；低地位职业（janitor、farm worker、construction worker）则 V–VI 型超过 48%；即便"a smiling person"这类中性提示也有 80%+ 落在 I–II 型，呈明显身份—地位—肤色关联偏见。
2) 现有缓解手段的局限：训练/微调类方法（debiasing、unlearning、轻量适配器）成本高、不透明且终端用户不可及；推理期方法（EntiGen、ITI-GEN、Fair Diffusion）虽更轻量，但往往隐含固定单一公平观（默认均匀），且多需白盒访问模型内部（Fair Diffusion 的潜空间编辑）或额外训练（ITI-GEN 的 token embedding 学习）、硬编码人口实体（EntiGen）。
3) 论文的核心问题意识："谁定义了公平？"——公平规范是可争议的，框架应把目标变为显式、可审计、可替换的输入，而非由系统暗中假定；此前工作缺乏"意图分布 vs. 实际分布"之间可量化的差距审计。
4) 由此提出的具体研究缺口：需要一个既能跨模型迁移（仅依赖文本接口）、又能支持分级可控目标、并能对"声明目标—生成结果"对齐度进行透明审计的用户中心式框架。
AI.method:
框架为"用户可控公平模块 + LLM 中介 + 固定 T2I 生成器"三段式流水线：
(1) 用户指定公平范围与目标分布 q：可选均匀分布、区域/职业真实人口统计（如美国某职业的族裔构成）、LLM 检索的现实统计，或用户自定义的社会政治目标；同时允许"人口中性生成"模式。
(2) LLM（GPT-4o，模型无关，可换 Claude/Gemini）作为"知识引擎"：识别与提示相关的人口维度，检索带引用来源的比例，给出置信度；并把原提示改写为子群提示变体（如 "a doctor who is Black or African American"、"a doctor with dark skin"）。当提示定义不清或缺乏可靠人口统计（如"a happy person"）时，LLM 被强制返回置信度 0.0，系统触发回退（fallback）机制：默认在 Fitzpatrick I–VI 上均匀（各约 16.7%），用户可自定义。所有改写提示、比例、置信度、来源以 JSON 记录，供复现与审计。
(3) 生成与预算分配：按 N_i ≈ q_i·N（round 并调整 ±1 使总和为 N）为各子群分配固定图像预算，逐子群提示送入 T2I 模型生成。
评估：RetinaFace 裁脸 → derm-ita 计算 ITA → 映射 Fitzpatrick I–VI（并用 Monk Skin Tone MST 1–10 交叉验证）；以 Alignment Error = Σ(p_i − q_i)² 衡量对齐（目标直接定义在肤色空间时计算，否则报告方向性位移并审计分配日志）。
实验设计：36 个提示（30 职业，按 SIOPS 划分高/中/低地位各 10；6 个非职业情境），共 6,600 张图；每个职业 50 张基线 + 每种目标设定（Uniform / Intermediate / Extreme）各 50 张；主要模型 SD Realistic Vision v5.1（768×512，40 步，CFG 7.5，float16，固定种子），另在 SDXL Turbo、SD 1.5、DALL·E 2 上以 Uniform 目标验证迁移性。职业列表由 GPT-4o/Claude 提议后人工校核并对齐 ISCO-88/SIOPS。Intermediate 定义为 q_int = α·r + (1−α)·q_uni（α=0.5），Extreme 为单组聚焦的集中分布（含 α=1 退化情形），后者仅作为可控性/可审计性压力测试。对比基线：EntiGen、ITI-GEN、Fair Diffusion。
AI.result:
1) 基线偏差刻画：高地位职业 Fitzpatrick II 型占 69%、V–VI 合计 <2%；低地位职业 V–VI >48%、I–II 仅 24%；中地位居中（II 33%、V–VI 18%），证实偏见随职业声望系统性变化而非个别提示异常。
2) Uniform 目标下：三类地位组的方差型对齐误差平均下降 76.7%（0.129→0.030），高地位组降幅最大（0.179→0.023）；Type II 从 69% 降至 27%，V–VI 从 <2% 升至 30%；低地位职业 Type VI 由 34% 降至 18%。跨模型泛化良好：SDXL Turbo 改善 91.1%（0.147→0.013）、DALL·E 2 77.3%、SD 1.5 68.6%；MST 标度结果与 Fitzpatrick 一致。
3) 非职业提示（回退机制）：抽象/情感类基线 I–II 超 80%，回退后接近六型均匀；刑事刻板印象类基线偏暗，回退后各型与 16.7% 目标偏差在 2% 以内；社会经济类同样趋于均匀。
4) 基线对比：EntiGen 与 ITI-GEN 平均对齐误差 0.378/0.335，反而比无干预基线（0.129）更差，且输出高度塌缩到深肤色（EntiGen 各地位组 V–VI 占 77.9%/76.6%/92.9%）——原因是扩散模型对肤色描述符响应不对称（浅肤色是默认、罕被显式标注，"light skin"几乎无效果，"dark skin"则强烈偏移）；Fair Diffusion 平均 0.086（中等地位组低至 0.009），但低地位组因编辑方向与已有暗色倾向叠加反而恶化至 0.170，高于基线 0.087。本文方法平均 0.030 最优，比最强基线平均领先约 65%。
5) 可控性：Intermediate 目标产生介于基线与 Uniform 之间的分布（高地位组 Light/Medium/Dark = 0.482/0.256/0.262），Extreme 目标（Black 80%）使 Type VI 达 86%（三箱聚合 12%/2%/86%），证实单调分级的响应性。定性结果（Fig. 6/23）显示本文方法输出在肤色谱上分布最均匀。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心贡献不是提供一个"正确的"公平目标，而是把代表性目标重述为管线中一个可检视、可记录、可审计的显式输入（uniform、语境统计或用户自定义），并证明 prompt 层干预即可在不改动扩散模型权重的前提下跨生成器迁移、单调且可预测地改变观测到的肤色分布，且优于现有推理期去偏基线。方法论上的启示是：公平干预应当把规范性选择（normative choice）显式化并可被质询，从而支持下游问责；用户可对照已声明目标评估输出的取舍，并就"何种表征算合适"展开公共讨论。局限包括：LLM 检索的人口统计可能有偏或错误并向生成结果传导；自动肤色估计（Fitzpatrick/ITA）较粗糙、受光照与风格化与人脸检测失败影响，且不刻画身份与交叉性属性；未评估"概念渗漏"（子群描述符可能意外改变背景、服装、表情等其他视觉属性）；推理期干预无法消除训练数据/模型内部偏见，仅是训练期缓解与治理的补充，且由于目标由用户控制，存在被滥用于排斥性偏好的伦理风险，故论文将贡献定位为透明性与可控性而非公平性保证。未来工作方向：考察实践中用户如何指定目标；扩展到多属性并妥善处理属性交互；改进当目标与评估处于不同人口抽象层次（如族裔标签 vs. 肤色）时的审计方法。

title: Probably Approximately Consensus: On the Learning Theory of Finding Common Ground
comment: Accepted to the Social Choice and Learning Algorithms Workshop at IJCAI 2025
summary: A primary goal of online deliberation platforms is to identify ideas that are broadly agreeable to a community of users through their expressed preferences. Yet, consensus elicitation should ideally extend beyond the specific statements provided by users and should incorporate the relative salience of particular topics. We address this issue by modelling consensus as an interval in a one-dimensional opinion space derived from potentially high-dimensional data via embedding and dimensionality reduction. We define an objective that maximizes expected agreement within a hypothesis interval where the expectation is over an underlying distribution of issues, implicitly taking into account their salience. We propose an efficient Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM) algorithm and establish PAC-learning guarantees. Our initial experiments demonstrate the performance of our algorithm and examine more efficient approaches to identifying optimal consensus regions. We find that through selectively querying users on an existing sample of statements, we can reduce the number of queries needed to a practical number.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在线协商平台中如何识别社区用户普遍认同的观点，提出将共识建模为一维意见空间中的区间，通过嵌入和降维处理高维数据，并利用PAC学习框架提供理论保证，实验表明通过选择性查询可高效识别最优共识区域。
AI.motivation: 在线协商平台的核心目标之一是识别社区用户普遍认同的观点，但现有方法往往仅关注用户明确表达的陈述，忽略了不同议题的相对重要性（显著性）。因此需要一种能够同时考虑用户偏好和议题显著性的共识识别方法。
AI.method: 1) 通过嵌入和降维技术将高维用户偏好数据映射到一维意见空间；2) 将共识定义为一维空间中的一个区间；3) 提出经验风险最小化(ERM)算法，最大化潜在议题分布上的预期共识；4) 建立PAC学习保证。
AI.result: 实验验证了算法的有效性，证明通过在现有样本声明上进行选择性查询，可以将所需查询数量减少到实用水平。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够有效识别在线协商中的共识区域，在理论上有PAC学习保证，实践上具有较高的查询效率，为构建更智能的在线协商系统提供了新思路。

title: A Systematic Study of Biomedical Retrieval Pipeline Trade-offs in Performance and Efficiency
summary:
Retrieval systems are increasingly used in biomedical and clinical natural language processing applications, yet practical guidance for researchers building such systems is limited. In this work, we provide such guidance through an empirical study of how retrieval pipeline design choices affect performance and efficiency at scale.
  In particular, we examine retrieval over a variety of existing, public biomedical text datasets, leveraging a variety of disparate types of queries, including exam-style questions, conversational medical queries, community-asked questions, and non-question formulations across various retrieval pipeline settings spanning corpus selection, chunk granularity, and vector index configuration. Retrieval results are judged using a robust, win-rate comparison assessment via an LLM-as-a-judge setting with human validation.
  Across these experiments, we identify several points of concrete guidance for reviewers, including the superiority of corpus aggregation for absolute retrieval quality, and the emergence of MedRAG/pubmed as the Pareto-optimal singleton corpus under graph-based (HNSW) indexing, appropriate chunking strategies, and FAISS indexing choices that offer the best trade-offs in speed and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过大规模实证研究，系统评估了生物医学检索管道设计选择对性能和效率的影响，为研究者提供了包括语料库聚合策略、HNSW索引下MedRAG/pubmed的Pareto最优性、chunking策略及FAISS索引权衡在内的具体实践指导。
AI.motivation: 生物医学和临床NLP应用中检索系统的使用日益增加，但研究者构建此类系统时缺乏实践指导。
AI.method: 通过在多种公共生物医学文本数据集上进行实验，系统性地评估不同检索管道设置（语料库选择、chunk粒度、向量索引配置），使用LLM-as-a-judge框架结合人工验证进行win-rate评估。
AI.result: 发现语料库聚合对绝对检索质量的优势；MedRAG/pubmed在基于图（HNSW）索引下成为Pareto最优单语料库；确定了合适的chunking策略和FAISS索引的最佳速度效率权衡方案。
AI.conclusion: 研究为构建生物医学检索系统的研究者提供了可操作的建议，包括语料库聚合策略的选择、MedRAG/pubmed在HNSW索引下的Pareto最优性、chunking策略以及FAISS索引的效率权衡建议。

title: The Shrinking Sweet Spot: How Algorithms, Institutions, and Social Priors Shape Musical Ecosystems
summary: Why do some national music markets sustain a rich musical diversity whereas others converge on mostly formulaic output? The existing models of cultural consumption (superstar economics, rational addiction, Bayesian social learning) each capture part of the answer, but none can explain how exposure, social influence, institutional gatekeeping, and algorithmic curation interact to shape what listeners come to prefer. We address this gap by modeling musical taste as a learning process rather than a fixed parameter: a listener's evaluative disposition evolves with each encounter, shaped by the balance between the comfort of the familiar and the reward of the new. Drawing on the active inference framework from cognitive science, we formalize this as a sequential choice model in which preferences, information, and the consumption environment co-evolve, and show how the framework nests and extends key mechanisms from the three canonical economic models. An agent-based simulation generates four predictions: algorithmic curation suppresses consumption diversity beyond a sharp nonlinear threshold; institutional structure determines winner-take-all intensity through confirmatory cross-system contrasts; cultural capital buffers listeners against homogenization; and high-curation, high-conformity systems collapse supply-side dispersion relative to pluralistic ecosystems. We test the framework against four national music ecosystems (Italy's Festival di Sanremo, Brazil, South Korea, and the United Kingdom), identifying structural determinants of ecosystem vitality on both the supply and demand sides. The welfare implications are direct: because listeners' preferences adapt to impoverished environments through the very learning mechanisms the model describes, revealed preference analysis cannot reliably evaluate the outcomes of cultural markets.

AI.tldr: 该研究采用认知科学中的主动推理框架，将音乐品味建模为动态学习过程，揭示了算法策展、制度结构、文化资本和多元生态系统对音乐市场多样性的差异化影响，并指出显示性偏好分析在评估文化市场福利时的根本局限。
AI.motivation: 现有文化消费模型（超级明星经济学、理性成瘾、贝叶斯社会学习）各自捕捉了部分答案，但均无法解释曝光、社会影响、制度性守门人和算法策展如何交互作用以塑造听众偏好。该研究旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 采用主动推理框架（active inference）将音乐品味建模为学习过程而非固定参数。形式化为序贯选择模型，其中偏好、信息与消费环境共同演化，展示了该框架如何嵌套并扩展三个经典经济模型（超级明星经济学、理性成瘾、贝叶斯社会学习）。通过基于智能体的模拟生成预测，并在意大利圣雷莫音乐节、巴西、韩国和英国四个国家级音乐生态系统中进行实证检验。
AI.result: 模拟生成四个核心预测：(1) 算法策展在尖锐非线性阈值之外抑制消费多样性；(2) 制度结构通过跨系统确认性对比决定赢者通吃强度；(3) 文化资本缓冲听众免受同质化影响；(4) 高策展-高顺从系统在供给侧分散度上崩溃，显著区别于多元生态系统。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别了意大利圣雷莫音乐节、巴西、韩国和英国四个国家音乐生态系统的结构性决定因素。核心发现：福利影响方面，由于听众的偏好会通过模型所描述的学习机制适应贫乏的环境，因此显示性偏好分析无法可靠评估文化市场的结果；偏好是动态演化的而非固定参数，偏好适应的存在使传统市场评估方法失效；不同制度结构（高 curation/高 conformity 系统 vs 多元生态系统）对供给侧分散度有显著差异性影响。

title: A Metamorphic Testing Approach to Diagnosing Memorization in LLM-Based Program Repair
summary: LLM-based automated program repair (APR) techniques have shown promising results in reducing debugging costs. However, prior results can be affected by data leakage: large language models (LLMs) may memorize bug fixes when evaluation benchmarks overlap with their pretraining data, leading to inflated performance estimates. In this paper, we investigate whether we can better reveal data leakage by combining metamorphic testing (MT) with negative log-likelihood (NLL), which has been used in prior work as a proxy for memorization. We construct variant benchmarks by applying semantics-preserving transformations to two widely used datasets, Defects4J and GitBug-Java. Using these benchmarks, we evaluate the repair success rates of seven LLMs on both original and transformed versions, and analyze the relationship between performance degradation and NLL. Our results show that all evaluated state-of-the-art LLMs exhibit substantial drops in patch generation success rates on transformed benchmarks, ranging from -4.1% for GPT-4o to -15.98% for Llama-3.1. Furthermore, we find that this degradation strongly correlates with NLL on the original benchmarks, suggesting that models perform better on instances they are more likely to have memorized. These findings show that combining MT with NLL provides stronger and more reliable evidence of data leakage, while metamorphic testing alone can help mitigate its effects in LLM-based APR evaluations.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）在自动程序修复（APR）中的数据泄露问题，提出将变体测试（MT）与负对数似然（NLL）结合的方法来更好地揭示数据泄露。实验表明，所有评估的LLM在变换后的基准数据集上都出现了显著的性能下降，且性能退化与NLL高度相关。
AI.motivation: LLM-based APR技术可能受到数据泄露的影响——评估基准与预训练数据重叠时，LLM可能已记忆了修复方案，导致性能估计被夸大。现有方法难以可靠地检测这种泄露，需要更有效的验证手段。
AI.method: 对Defects4J和GitBug-Java两个广泛使用的数据集应用语义保持变换构建变体基准，评估7个LLM在原始版本和变换版本上的修复成功率，并分析性能下降与NLL之间的关系。
AI.result: 所有最先进的LLM在变换后的基准上都表现出显著的补丁生成成功率下降，范围从GPT-4o的-4.1%到Llama-3.1的-15.98%。性能退化与原始基准上的NLL强相关，表明模型在其更可能记忆的实例上表现更好。
AI.conclusion: MT与NLL的结合提供了更强且更可靠的数据泄露证据；变体测试alone可帮助缓解LLM-based APR评估中的数据泄露效应，为更公平的性能评估提供了方法。

title: Clinically Interpretable Sepsis Early Warning via LLM-Guided Simulation of Temporal Physiological Dynamics
summary: Timely and interpretable early warning of sepsis remains a major clinical challenge due to the complex temporal dynamics of physiological deterioration. Traditional data-driven models often provide accurate yet opaque predictions, limiting physicians' confidence and clinical applicability. To address this limitation, we propose a Large Language Model (LLM)-guided temporal simulation framework that explicitly models physiological trajectories prior to disease onset for clinically interpretable prediction. The framework consists of a spatiotemporal feature extraction module that captures dynamic dependencies among multivariate vital signs, a Medical Prompt-as-Prefix module that embeds clinical reasoning cues into LLMs, and an agent-based post-processing component that constrains predictions within physiologically plausible ranges. By first simulating the evolution of key physiological indicators and then classifying sepsis onset, our model offers transparent prediction mechanisms that align with clinical judgment. Evaluated on the MIMIC-IV and eICU databases, the proposed method achieves superior AUC scores (0.861-0.903) across 24-4-hour pre-onset prediction tasks, outperforming conventional deep learning and rule-based approaches. More importantly, it provides interpretable trajectories and risk trends that can assist clinicians in early intervention and personalized decision-making in intensive care environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于大语言模型(LLM)指导的时间模拟框架，用于脓毒症早期预警。该框架通过时空特征提取、医学提示前缀模块和基于智能体的后处理组件，在保持可解释性的同时实现准确的早期预测。
AI.motivation: 脓毒症早期预警面临重大临床挑战，主要原因包括：1) 生理功能衰退的复杂时间动态特性；2) 传统数据驱动模型虽准确但缺乏透明度，限制临床医生信任度和应用性。
AI.method: 框架包含三个核心模块：1) 时空特征提取模块—捕获多变量生命体征间的动态依赖关系；2) 医学提示前缀模块—将临床推理线索嵌入LLM；3) 基于智能体的后处理组件—将预测约束在生理合理范围内。采用先模拟关键生理指标演变、再进行脓毒症分类的双阶段策略。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV和eICU数据库上，该方法在24-4小时预警任务中达到0.861-0.903的AUC评分，优于传统深度学习和基于规则的方法。同时提供可解释的生理指标轨迹和风险趋势。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过将LLM与临床推理相结合，实现了准确且透明的脓毒症早期预测，为重症监护环境中的早期干预和个性化决策提供了可解释的辅助工具。

title: Beyond Pixels: Introspective and Interactive Grounding for Visualization Agents
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) frequently misread values, hallucinate details, and confuse overlapping elements in charts. Current approaches rely solely on pixel interpretation, creating a Pixel-Only Bottleneck: agents treat interactive charts as static images, losing access to the structured specification that encodes exact values. We introduce Introspective and Interactive Visual Grounding (IVG), a framework that combines (1) spec-grounded introspection, which queries the underlying specification for deterministic evidence, with (2) view-grounded interaction, which manipulates the view to resolve visual ambiguity. To enable evaluation without VLM bias, we present iPlotBench, a benchmark of 500 interactive Plotly figures with 6,706 binary questions and ground-truth specifications. Experiments show that introspection improves data reconstruction fidelity, while the combination with interaction achieves the highest QA accuracy (0.81), with +6.7 % gains on overlapping geometries. We further demonstrate IVG in deployed agents that explore data autonomously and collaborate with human users in real time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 IVG（Introspective and Interactive Visual Grounding）框架，解决可视化智能体只依赖像素解读图表导致的"仅像素瓶颈"问题：智能体通过 MCP 工具直接查询图表的 Plotly 规范（spec-grounded introspection）获得精确数值，并通过缩放/平移、图例切换、框选（view-grounded interaction）获取"焦点上下文"消解视觉歧义。作者同时发布 iPlotBench（500 个交互式 Plotly 图、6,706 个二元问题、真值规范），并提出确定性指标 Semantic Structural Similarity。实验显示：内省主要提升图表重建保真度（S_Data 0.8847→0.9016），内省+交互组合取得最高 QA 准确率（0.8062），重叠几何问题上提升 +6.7%。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在图表理解上频繁误读数值、幻觉细节、混淆重叠元素。现有智能体仅通过静态像素理解交互式图表，丢弃了其中编码精确数值、轴范围、轨迹定义的结构化规范，形成"仅像素瓶颈（Pixel-Only Bottleneck）"：既无法查询真值，也无法通过缩放/切换/选择主动消解歧义。这在数据分析场景下会导致结论性错误，而非表层措辞问题。同时，现有评测基准（ChartQA、ChartMimic 等）把图表当作静态图像并使用 VLM 打分，评测器本身带有与待测能力相同的感知偏差，无法确定性评估。
AI.method: IVG 由两个互补机制组成：(1) 规范锚定的内省（spec-grounded introspection）——通过 get_plot_json 直接读取生成图表的完整 Plotly JSON 规范（数据数组、绑定、视觉属性），对精确数值与图例做符号化验证；(2) 视图锚定的交互（view-grounded interaction）——通过 relayout（缩放/平移，得 axis range）、legendclick（切换轨迹，得 trace index）、selected（区域选择，得数据空间包围盒及点数）产生"焦点上下文"，作为检索规范子集的搜索键。二者形成迭代工作流：直接可定位则内省足够，否则先交互获取焦点再在焦点范围内内省。实现为基于 Model Context Protocol 的 Visualization State API（基础工具 show_plot/get_plot_image，内省 get_plot_json，交互 relayout/legendclick/selected/query_interactions），带信任边界（只能访问自建图表）。评测基准 iPlotBench：借鉴 FigureQA 程序化生成流程，500 图（五类各 100）、6,706 个二元问题（15 个模板，分聚合/比较/拓扑三类，每图 Yes/No 严格 50/50），配真值 Plotly JSON。任务一为图表重建，指标 Semantic Structural Similarity：先用 Chamfer 距离 + 匈牙利匹配对齐真值与预测轨迹，再计算 S_Type（轨迹类型）、S_Data（Chamfer 指数惩罚，λ=5）、S_Text（角色感知模糊 Jaccard，角色含 Title/Axis/Legend/Annotations）、S_Style（CIELAB 颜色、mode/symbol/size/dash/width），统一以 max(|T|,|P|) 为分母惩罚多余/缺失轨迹；任务二为二元视觉 QA，报告准确率。四种配置消融：Vision、+Inter、+Intro、Full，同一提示模板与工具 schema，主实验用 Claude Haiku 4.5，扩展到 Qwen-VL 系列做模型规模分析；另做 λ 敏感性分析、以 S_Data≥0.9 条件化的去混淆分析、按问题类型的条件化分析。部署三种工作流：实时人机协作（用户点击/框选转为焦点上下文）、自主探索（Deep Plot，产出可交互、带证据链接的报告）、ML 方案搜索（MCTS + git worktree 并行，节点存 commit hash 与验证指标）；并做 12 人盲法被试内用户研究。
AI.result: 任务一（重建）：+Intro 最优，S_Type 0.9542→0.9807，S_Data 0.8847→0.9016，S_Style 0.8699→0.8749；+Inter 的 S_Text 略高（0.9903，因暴露被遮挡标签）；Full 未超过 +Intro（多余交互消耗工具预算、干扰规范层面修正）。任务二（QA）：Full 总体最高 0.8062（Vision 0.7783，+Inter 0.7850，+Intro 0.8023）；增益集中在 Line（0.7292）与 Dot-Line（0.7522），Bar/Pie 则 +Intro 最佳，说明几何不歧义时直接读规范已足够。按图计准确率与条件化准确率同样呈 Full 最高（0.8199 / 0.8637）；+Intro 擅长 Comparison，Full 擅长 Topology（0.8052）。工具使用：Line/Dot-Line 上 relayout、legendclick、selected 调用率极高，Bar/Pie 几乎不用；提供内省后交互调用总数下降约 71%。λ∈{1,3,5,7,10} 下配置排序稳定。模型规模：约 20B 以上激活参数模型（Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B、Qwen-VL-Max）持续获益（QA 0.951→0.960、0.971→0.973，条件化 Δ 达 +0.005/+0.002，Topology 增益最大 +0.008），小模型（30B-A3B）反而退化（条件化 −0.059），表明工具编排需足够推理容量；接近上限的前沿模型其 IVG 价值转向可审计性与可追溯证据。用户研究：12 人中 11 人偏好 IVG 智能体，9 人认为其为最佳选项，正确引用数值 4.5/5、结论有可见证据 4.4/5、正确识别交互区域 4.9/5，但"发现新模式"仅 3.4/5，说明当前系统更擅长验证而非开放性发现。
AI.conclusion: IVG 通过把智能体从被动观察者转变为其可视化输出的主动所有者，解决了仅像素瓶颈：内省提供确定性证据，交互提供焦点上下文，二者互补而非冗余。智能体会依据图表复杂度自适应平衡两种机制（歧义大时用交互、歧义小时直接读规范）。贡献包括：IVG 工具包（MCP 化、可被任意兼容智能体调用）、iPlotBench 基准与确定性 Semantic Structural Similarity 指标，以及覆盖实时协作、自主探索、ML 方案搜索的部署验证。局限：仅在 Plotly 上做实证验证，推广到其他语法库需适配规范格式与事件模型；基准仅用二元 QA 以保证确定性，开放式分析仅定性演示，系统化开放式基准留作未来工作；对小模型而言工具编排能力不足，需更大容量模型才能获益。

title: Active Data
summary: In some complex domains, certain problem-specific decompositions can provide advantages over monolithic designs by enabling comprehension and specification of the design. In this paper we present an intuitive and tractable approach to reasoning over large and complex data sets. Our approach is based on Active Data, i.e., data as atomic objects that actively interact with environments. We describe our intuition about how this bottom-up approach improves designs confronting computational and conceptual complexity. We describe an implementation of the base Active Data concepts within the air traffic flow management domain and discuss performance for this implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于"主动数据"(Active Data)的自底向上方法，通过将数据视为主动与环境交互的原子对象，来处理大型复杂数据集。该方法在空管流量管理领域得到实现并验证了其性能优势。
AI.motivation: Traditional monolithic designs often struggle with large and complex datasets. By leveraging problem-specific decompositions, this paper aims to improve both the comprehension and specification of system designs, enabling more intuitive and tractable reasoning in complex domains.
AI.method: The approach uses Active Data, where data is conceptualized as atomic objects that actively interact with their environment. This bottom-up decomposition strategy breaks down complex systems into manageable, interacting components rather than treating data as passive entities.
AI.result: The implementation demonstrates practical viability in the air traffic flow management domain, with performance results validating the effectiveness of the proposed approach for handling computational and conceptual complexity.
AI.conclusion: The paper presents a proof-of-concept implementation in the air traffic flow management domain, demonstrating the practical applicability of the Active Data approach. Performance evaluations confirm the viability of this bottom-up decomposition strategy for handling large-scale, complex datasets in real-world scenarios.

title: ERA: Evidence-based Reliability Alignment for Honest Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds language models in factual evidence but introduces critical challenges regarding knowledge conflicts between internalized parameters and retrieved information. However, existing reliability methods, typically relying on scalar confidence, fail to explicitly distinguish between epistemic uncertainty and inherent data ambiguity in such hybrid scenarios. In this paper, we propose a new framework called ERA (Evidence-based Reliability Alignment) to enhance abstention behavior in RAG systems by shifting confidence estimation from scalar probabilities to explicit evidence distributions. Our method consists of two main components: (1) Contextual Evidence Quantification, which models internal and external knowledge as independent belief masses via the Dirichlet distribution, and (2) Quantifying Knowledge Conflict, which leverages Dempster-Shafer Theory (DST) to rigorously measure the geometric discordance between information sources. These components are used to disentangle epistemic uncertainty from aleatoric uncertainty and modulate the optimization objective based on detected conflicts. Experiments on standard benchmarks and a curated generalization dataset demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms baselines, optimizing the trade-off between answer coverage and abstention with superior calibration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ERA框架，通过将标量置信度估计转向显式证据分布来增强RAG系统的弃权行为。核心创新在于利用Dirichlet分布建模知识证据和DST理论量化冲突，从而解耦认知不确定性和随机不确定性。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成(RAG)系统面临内部化参数知识与检索信息之间的知识冲突问题，而现有可靠性方法主要依赖标量置信度，无法显式区分认知不确定性(epistemic uncertainty)和数据固有模糊性(aleatoric uncertainty)。
AI.method: 提出ERA框架，包含两个核心组件：(1)上下文证据量化，使用Dirichlet分布将内部参数知识和外部检索知识建模为独立信念质量；(2)基于Dempster-Shafer Theory(DST)量化信息源间的几何不一致性。该框架通过证据分布而非标量概率进行置信度估计，实现认知不确定性和随机不确定性的解耦，并根据检测到的冲突动态调制优化目标。
AI.result: 在标准基准测试和精选的泛化数据集上，该方法显著优于基线方法，在优化答案覆盖率和弃权权衡方面展现出更优的校准性能。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明该方法显著优于基线方法，在答案覆盖率和弃权之间实现了更优的权衡，展现出更优越的校准性能。

title: Strategic Polysemy in AI Discourse: A Philosophical Analysis of Language, Hype, and Power
comment: Accepted in the Ninth Annual ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (ACM FAccT) 2026
summary: This paper examines the strategic use of language in contemporary artificial intelligence (AI) discourse, focusing on the widespread adoption of metaphorical or colloquial terms like "hallucination", "chain-of-thought", "introspection", "language model", "alignment", and "agent". We argue that many such terms exhibit strategic polysemy: they sustain multiple interpretations simultaneously, combining narrow technical definitions with broader anthropomorphic or common-sense associations. In contemporary AI research and deployment contexts, this semantic flexibility produces significant institutional and discursive effects, shaping how AI systems are understood by researchers, policymakers, funders, and the public. To analyse this phenomenon, we introduce the concept of glosslighting: the practice of using technically redefined terms to evoke intuitive -- often anthropomorphic or misleading -- associations while preserving plausible deniability through restricted technical definitions. Glosslighting enables actors to benefit from the persuasive force of familiar language while maintaining the ability to retreat to narrower definitions when challenged. We argue that this practice contributes to AI hype cycles, facilitates the mobilisation of investment and institutional support, and influences public and policy perceptions of AI systems, while often deflecting epistemic and ethical scrutiny. By examining the linguistic dynamics of glosslighting and strategic polysemy, the paper highlights how language itself functions as a sociotechnical mechanism shaping the development and governance of AI.

AI.tldr: 本文（FAccT '26，LaCroix、Mallory、Luccioni）提出并系统论证两个概念：**战略多义（strategic polysemy）**——说话者有意或可预见地利用自然语言的固有弹性，同时维系窄化技术定义与宽泛的通俗/拟人化联想；以及由此派生的**“glosslighting”（涂抹式话语/玄光化）**——使用被重新技术化界定的术语去唤起熟悉的、有时具误导性的直觉意义，同时保留退守窄定义以否认该意义的空间。文章主张语言本身是塑造 AI 研发与治理的社会技术机制，并附有一份“去 glosslighting 术语翻译手册”表格。
AI.motivation:
1）AI 术语体系长期存在“俗称义与技术实态”之间的结构性落差（如“intelligence” 从无共识定义，“hallucination” 实为统计 token 预测下的输出偏离），且这一落差自 1955 年 McCarthy 命名 AI 起就已存在，并随深度学习/大模型而加剧。
2）当下 AI 话语的两个关键特征使“语言机会主义”收益空前放大：新造词（agentic、foundation model、chain-of-thought、hallucination 等）从技术语汇快速迁移为大众词汇并携带强烈拟人化色彩；AI 同时成为研究与商业/公共/政策话语的交汇点，术语在异质受众间流动时会“失语境”但仍保留修辞势能。
3）既有文献（AI hype、anthropomorphism、术语批评如 Rehak 2025、Inie et al. 2026、Rogers & Luccioni 2024）缺少对“为何这些模糊性被系统性保留并带来制度性收益”的概念化框架；同时关于 AI 语汇的批评多停留在描述层面，缺少规范的、可操作的术语实践方案。作者希望填补“从诊断到评价再到规范建议”的理论空白。
AI.method:
1）哲学语言学基础：区分多义（polysemy）与同音/同形异义（homonymy），强调义项间的“相关性”；引入“无辜多义 vs. 战略多义”的二分，并借 Camp（2018）的默许/会话记录（common ground / conversational record）模型、Stalnaker 与 Lewis 的语用学工具、Michaelson 的“sneaky reference”、Saul 的“dogwhistle”（含非故意型）理论，界定“可否认性”。
2）提出 glosslighting 概念定义（glossary + gaslight 的合成词，亦含 gloss/light 的双关），明确其既可能出于意图，也可能是“模糊术语 × 异质受众 × 制度激励”共同作用的系统性结果，故以“可预见性（foreseeability）”而非“意图”作为责任判准。
3）案例分析（Section 3）：逐一解剖 agent / agentic AI、hallucination、thinking-reasoning-chain-of-thought、introspection、language model、alignment 等术语的技术窄定义与通俗宽义，并叠加分析其引用的媒体标题、厂商表述与论文标题中的修辞策略（如 Wei et al. 2023 论文标题去掉引号；Ji-An et al. 2025 脚注式免责声明；Google 对 agent 的营销式定义）。
4）政治经济学分析（Section 4）：以 Placani（2024）“拟人化构成 hype 的组成部分”与 Bender & Hanna（2025）“hype 是事实与幻想的混合”为基础，说明媒体、风险投资、学术激励的趋同如何使模糊性成为结构性优势（technochauvinism、“the spectre of capitalism”）。
5）规范评价（Section 5）：从认知伤害、信任操控、责任稀释、技术批判空间收窄、优生学与种族科学历史回潮、自动化场景中的“客观性假象”（如 bias 术语）等维度给出规范性分析；并援引 Carnap（1950）的 explication 原则、Strawson（1963）的批评、McDermott（1976）对“wishful mnemonics”的批评与 Proudfoot（2011）构建三组对照。
6）附录 A 提供一张两列对照表（“hype-laden term” → “literal description”），作为面向媒体、政策与跨学科协作的实践性翻译工具。
AI.result:
1）建立了清晰的概念图谱：无辜多义是自然语言的常态，战略多义则是可被有意识或可预见地利用以获取修辞、金钱或意识形态收益的弹性；glosslighting 是战略多义在 AI 话语中的具体形态，区别于“空/浮动能指”（后者指意义的不确定性，前者指多个冲突但各自可信的解读的并存与差异化激活）。
2）通过对六个核心术语的解剖，证明“叠加的技术义 + 通俗义”结构在 AI 领域具有系统性：术语在学术、企业、媒体、投资四类制度场域中同时执行不同功能（标示新颖性、产品差异化、叙事性、规模化想象），因而“可资助、可发表、可上头条”。
3）指出拟人化语言并非 hype 的伴随物，而是 hype 的构成要素：它制造出系统能“思考/推理/理解/决策”的幻觉，从而生成错误的能力预期、放大 AGI/超级智能式的空想叙事（同时放大乌托邦与恐慌），并使责任在“agent 而非 tool”的框定中被稀释。
4）给出规范性判断：在非专家几乎必然作拟人化解读的情境下继续使用此类术语，加脚注与免责声明不足以免责，构成对可预见后果的“故意漠视”（wilful disregard）；但并非一切隐喻皆恶——隐喻在理论建构与跨学科互惠中可具建设性（RL 与神经科学中的 reward/policy 反馈），关键分野在于语境、受众与流通速度（“model fit”）。
5）提出以“语言透明性”为核心的负责任传播框架：研究者/企业可主动选择精确、非隐喻的技术描述（放弃修辞吸引力），科学传播者与记者对所复制的解释框架亦负有部分责任，可通过弃用含混术语来抑制 hype 与恐慌。
AI.conclusion: AI 话语中的模糊性不是偶发的沟通瑕疵，而是自 AI 研究起点即存在、并由研究—企业—媒体—投资四方激励共同再生产的稳定制度特征。glosslighting 的危害不在于“语言有时会误导”这一层面，而在于它系统性地让强势行为体获利、把风险外部化给脆弱群体：它扭曲认知规范（掩盖系统的概率性、脆弱性与工具性）、稀释问责、以“创新”名义正当化有害应用，并挤压有意义批评的空间；同时它还可能复活优生学与种族科学式的智力等级论。正因如此，负责任的科学传播不能止于免责声明与引号，必须抵制那些其可预见的接受效果必然误导非专家受众的战略模糊术语——语言透明性是 AI 时代“认知正义”的前提条件，控制 AI 语言者即控制其风险、收益与失败如何被理解、以及由谁来理解。附录的术语翻译手册为研究者提供了把这一规范主张落地为具体措辞选择的操作工具，但作者同时强调其是沟通辅助而非规定性词汇表。

title: DryRUN: On the Role of Public Tests in LLM-Driven Code Generation
summary: Multi-agent frameworks are widely used in autonomous code generation and have applications in complex algorithmic problem-solving. Recent work has addressed the challenge of generating functionally correct code by incorporating simulation-driven planning and debugging, where language models trace execution steps to verify logic. However, these approaches depend on human-provided public test cases to ground the debugging and simulation loop. Manually authoring comprehensive input-output examples is a labor-intensive bottleneck in the software development lifecycle. Because ground-truth input-output examples are rarely available prior to implementation in real-world software engineering, this dependency restricts methods to curated competitive programming benchmarks. Furthermore, we identify that reliance on these public tests induces an ``overconfidence gap,'' causing frameworks to overfit to simplistic examples and fail on hidden evaluations. In contrast, we observe that external sample inputs are not strictly necessary for code generation. We demonstrate that large language models can autonomously generate valid inputs and simulate execution traces to self-correct. Consequently, we develop DryRUN, a framework that eliminates the need for ground-truth samples by allowing the LLM to iteratively plan, autonomously generate its own inputs and simulate execution, mitigating algorithmic overconfidence. Evaluations on the LiveCodeBench v6 dataset (post-March 2025) demonstrate that DryRUN matches performance against CodeSIM, a state-of-the-art and public-test-dependent framework, while operating entirely without public test cases or external execution feedback while reducing output token consumption.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DryRUN框架，通过让LLM自主生成输入和模拟执行轨迹来替代依赖人工测试用例的代码生成方法，在保持性能的同时消除了对公共测试的依赖并降低了计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有代码生成框架依赖人工提供的公共测试用例来驱动调试和仿真循环，但手工编写全面的输入输出示例劳动密集且在现实软件开发中难以获得；此外识别出对公共测试的依赖导致"过度自信差距"，使框架过度拟合简单示例而在隐藏评估上失败。
AI.method: DryRUN框架允许LLM迭代式规划，自主生成输入并模拟执行，通过避免依赖公共测试用例和外部执行反馈来缓解算法过度自信问题。该框架在LiveCodeBench v6数据集（2025年3月后）上进行评估。
AI.result: DryRUN在无需公共测试用例或外部执行反馈的条件下匹配了依赖公共测试的SOTA方法CodeSIM的性能，同时降低了输出令牌消耗。
AI.conclusion: DryRUN框架证明了外部样本输入对于代码生成并非严格必要，LLM可以自主生成有效输入并模拟执行轨迹进行自我修正，在消除对公共测试用例依赖的同时匹配现有SOTA方法性能并降低令牌消耗。

title: Promoting Simple Agents: Ensemble Methods for Event-Log Prediction
summary: We compare lightweight automata-based models (n-grams) with neural architectures (LSTM, Transformer) for next-activity prediction in streaming event logs. Experiments on synthetic patterns and five real-world process mining datasets show that n-grams with appropriate context windows achieve comparable accuracy to neural models while requiring substantially fewer resources. Unlike windowed neural architectures, which show unstable performance patterns, n-grams provide stable and consistent accuracy. While we demonstrate that classical ensemble methods like voting improve n-gram performance, they require running many agents in parallel during inference, increasing memory consumption and latency. We propose an ensemble method, the promotion algorithm, that dynamically selects between two active models during inference, reducing overhead compared to classical voting schemes. On real-world datasets, these ensembles match or exceed the accuracy of non-windowed neural models with lower computational cost.

AI.tldr: 本文面向流程挖掘中的流式"下一活动预测"任务，系统比较了轻量级 n-gram（PDFA 实现）与神经模型（LSTM、Transformer）在不同上下文窗口下的准确率、训练与推理开销，并提出"提升算法（Promotion Algorithm）"——一种仅需并行运行 2 个活跃 n-gram 代理、动态在窗口大小不同的模型间切换的集成方法。结论是：n-gram 在合适窗口下准确率可与神经模型相当而资源消耗远低；该集成在真实数据集上达到或超过无窗口神经模型的精度，且计算成本更低。
AI.motivation: 现代信息系统持续产生按时间排序的事件日志（医院患者、服务工单、证书生命周期等），需要在事件尚未发生前预测下一个活动，以支撑健康监测、预测性资源分配、风险反制等实时应用。现有方法复杂度不断上升：基于代理（agent-based）架构虽精度高，但由高参数 LLM 作为中央"预言机"成为吞吐与延迟瓶颈；而主流的 n-gram、LSTM、Transformer 等单体语言模型在流式场景下受限于窗口（context window）大小的选择：窗口过小则丢失关键历史信息，窗口过大则参数过多、训练数据不足导致精度下降，且 Transformer 在窗口超过其注意力容量后还会急剧退化。此外，经典集成方法（如投票）虽能缓解窗口选择难题，却需并行运行大量代理，带来内存与延迟开销。因此需要一个既稳定鲁棒、又能低成本运行的方案。
AI.method:
形式化：设活动字母表 Σ 与特殊符号 stop，语言模型即概率预测函数 p: Σ* → Δ(Σ∪{stop})；n-gram 模型仅依赖历史的最后 n−1 个符号，实现为概率确定有限自动机（PDFA），状态即历史后缀，训练只需累加频次计数，可增量流式更新。基线包括 LSTM（2 层堆叠、隐藏维 128）与 Transformer（单层单头因果编码器 + RoPE），并在流式设定下均截断为滑动窗口，另设无窗口（无界上下文）版本作对照；另加 soft voting（平均概率分布）、adaptive voting（在线跟踪各模型准确率选优）两种集成。

数据集与实验：合成数据集 I（确定性周期模式 A³B³、A³B²）与合成数据集 II（随机化周期模式 xx x̄（字典 {AAB,BBA}）、xAxB（{AAAB,BABB}）、xABxBA（{AABABA,BABBBA}），涵盖循环、变体选择与"标记位"辨别等特征），并为每种模式与窗口长度计算理论最优准确率作为上界；真实数据为 5 个公开流程挖掘数据集（Sepsis 2016、BPI 2012/2013/2017/2018，事件数 15,214 ~ 2,514,266）。训练配置：Adam、学习率 1e-3、batch 8、最多 20 epoch、验证集早停（patience 3）、梯度裁剪；7/15/15 划分；硬件为 i9-11900K + RTX 3090；实验均在 logicsponge 框架中实现。

核心方法——提升算法（Algorithm 1）：维护窗口递增的 n-gram 基模型列表 M₁,…,M_ℓ，初始以最小窗口模型 M_i 为活跃模型，同时并行追踪下一个窗口更大的模型 M_{i+1}；每步输出 M_i 的预测，待真实活动到来后更新两者的准确率计数；若 Acc(M_{i+1}) > Acc(M_i) 则累加提升计数器 c，连续达到阈值 τ（预实验经验标定为 20）时将 M_{i+1} 提升为活跃模型并重置计数器与 M_i 的准确率计数（保证公平比较）。仅 2 个代理同时活跃，故开销远低于需并行全部窗口模型的投票方案。动机在于实验发现 n-gram 的精度衰减随训练数据增多而右移，因此更大的窗口模型有可能在后续阶段胜出，动态提升可自动适配数据量与过程结构。
AI.result: 合成数据：所有模型在窗口足够小时均达到理论最优（A³B³ 上 99.95%）；Transformer 在窗口 >16 后明显退化（LSTM 相对稳定但在高窗口偶发下跌），n-gram 在大数据量下保持"平台期"但窗口过大时因数据稀疏而精度崩塌，且崩塌点随数据量增加右移；LSTM 在 win=7、16 出现学习失败（50%）。真实数据：LSTM 精度最高（5-gram 仅略低，如 BPI 2012 84.83% vs 85.87%，BPI 2018 71.90% vs 82.07%），soft voting 集成可达或超过单体模型（如 Sepsis 65.68%、BPI 2017 87.16%、BPI 2018 74.57%）；提升算法在不需手动选择窗口超参的前提下达到相当精度（BPI 2018 达 75.80%，优于 soft voting），且推理延迟最低（62 μs/事件，接近单个 5-gram 的 57 μs），显著低于 soft voting（97 μs）、adaptive voting（129 μs）、LSTM[win:4]（1106 μs）、Transformer[win:4]（2696 μs）；训练时间方面 n-gram 仅 6–50 μs/事件，而 LSTM/Transformer 高达 3370–8308 μs。
AI.conclusion: n-gram 这类轻量自动机模型在流式下一活动预测中具备与神经模型相当甚至更优的准确率，且训练/推理成本极低、对窗口大小呈"平台式"稳定；神经模型则对窗口高度敏感且易出现突发性崩溃。经典投票式集成能提升精度但需并行运行全部代理，内存与延迟开销大。本文提出的提升算法只需 2 个并行活跃代理，通过动态晋升机制自动适配最优窗口，在真实数据集上以更低计算成本匹配或超过无窗口 LSTM/Transformer 的精度。未来工作包括：在线学习与 τ 及 n-gram 集合的自动标定、引入"降级（demotion）"机制以应对概念漂移、以及复用低阶 n-gram 的结构与参数来初始化高阶模型。

title: Unsupervised Learning of Inter-Object Relationships via Group Homomorphism
summary: While current deep learning models achieve high performance by learning statistical correlations from vast datasets,which stands in stark contrast to human learning. They lack the flexibility of humans-particularly preverbal infants-to autonomously acquire the underlying structure of the world from limited experience and adapt to novel situations. In this study, we propose an unsupervised representation learning method based on a hierarchical relationship in group operations, rather than statistical independence, aiming to build a computational model of the cognitive development of infants. The proposed model features an integrated architecture that simultaneously performs object segmentation and the extraction of motion laws from dynamic image sequences. By introducing the Homomorphism from algebra as a structural constraint within a neural network, the model structurally separates pixel-level changes into meaningful, decomposed transformation components, such as translation and deformation. Using interaction scenes (chasing and evading tasks) based on developmental science findings, we experimentally demonstrate that the model can segment multiple objects into individual slots without any ground-truth labels. Furthermore, we confirmed that relative movements between objects, such as approaching or receding, are accurately mapped and structured into a one-dimensional additive latent space. These results suggest that by introducing algebraic geometric constraints rather than relying solely on statistical correlation learning, physically interpretable "disentangled representations" can be acquired. This study contributes to the understanding of the process by which infants internalize environmental laws as structures and provides a new perspective for constructing artificial systems with developmental intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于群同态（group homomorphism）的无监督表征学习方法，将代数几何约束嵌入神经网络，在无任何标签的情况下同时完成多物体分割、物体运动分解（平移与形变分离）以及物体间相对关系的提取。实验基于模仿婴儿追逐/躲避范式的合成图像序列，模型成功把追逐者与躲避者分到不同 slot，并将「接近/远离」这类相对运动映射到一维可加标量潜空间，验证了代数结构约束可替代纯统计相关性学习，产生物理可解释的解耦表征。
