These findings are robust across prompt mitigation strategies, varying numbers of attributes, and different pipeline difficulty levels. Our results challenge simple conditionals as valid proxies for bias evaluation and suggest current benchmarks underestimate bias risk in practical deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，既有的「代码生成偏见」评测几乎都建立在简单的 if 条件语句上，只能捕获显性歧视，严重低估了真实场景中的偏见风险。作者提出以「机器学习流水线生成中的特征选择」这一更贴近现实、更隐性的任务来衡量偏见：对 7 个公平敏感数据集、10 个 LLM（通用指令模型 + 代码专用模型）生成 350 个样本，结果显示敏感属性平均出现在 87.7%~88.3% 的流水线中，而条件语句中仅为 58.7%~59.2%；200 个「模型—数据集—属性」组合中 98% 显著偏离无偏基线。结论是：条件语句作为偏见代理指标不成立，现有基准低估了部署风险，需要基于端到端真实编程任务的偏见评测。
AI.motivation: 现有代码生成公平性研究（Liu et al. 2023、CodeGenBias、FairCoder、Solar 等）普遍以显式条件语句（if-else 直接将受保护属性映射到结果）作为偏见载体，只度量「显性歧视」（overt discrimination）。作者指出两类缺陷：(1) 条件语句只是真实编程的一小片切片；(2) 真实软件系统中的歧视更常以「隐性歧视」（covert discrimination）形式嵌入看似中立的设计决策中。在 ML 流水线里，最关键的隐性决策就是特征选择——把 race、sex、age 等敏感属性纳入预测特征即违反算法公平的基本原则「公平通过无知」（fairness through unawareness, Grgić-Hlača et al. 2016；Kusner et al. 2017）。此外监管（如 EU AI Act）鼓励收集敏感数据用于去偏与审计，使 LLM 在生成流水线时更频繁接触敏感特征。若 LLM 产出的隐性歧视率高于显性歧视率，则现有评测框架将根本性低估自动化代码生成的偏见风险。
AI.method: 评测范式：将偏见操作化为「生成的 ML 流水线是否将敏感属性作为预测特征」，并与条件语句条件做对照。数据集与提示：在 Huang et al. (2025) 的 3 个数据集（Adult Income、Employment Assessment、U.S. Health Insurance）基础上新增 COMPAS 再犯风险、Communities and Crime 暴力犯罪率、German Credit 信用评估、LSAC 律考通过率，共 7 个数据集；敏感属性定义沿用公平文献（Fabris et al. 2022），非敏感属性上限统一为 11 个，并额外加入 3 个显然无关的属性（ID number、favorite color、favorite prime number）作为「无关属性」对照；每个任务构造 50 个提示变体（GPT-5.1 辅助 + 人工在环），共 350 个样本，并随机打乱属性顺序以消除位置偏置。任务指令分别指定「使用条件语句」与「实现 <MLP / 随机森林 / SVM / 决策树 / 逻辑回归> 流水线」。模型：10 个 LLM——通用指令型（Gemma 3 27B、Llama 3.3 70B、Phi-4、Qwen2.5 72B、Qwen3-30B-A3B、GPT-5 Mini）与代码专用型（DeepSeek Coder 33B、Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B、Qwen2.5 Coder 32B、CodeGemma 7B）；4×H100，贪心解码，默认最大长度 512 token，批大小 128。指标：Code Bias Score（CBS）下沉到单个敏感属性粒度，CBS_i = 含属性 i 的生成函数数 / 总生成函数数；采用单样本比例 z 检验对零基线（ε=0.0001%）做假设检验，跨模型/数据集/属性的多重比较用 Bonferroni 校正，显著性 α=0.001。偏见抽取：用 LLM 抽取流水线（CoT 提示 + 匹配预定义敏感属性表），在 126 个人工标注样本上准确率 98%（最佳为 gemma-3-27b-it 98.41%，其他模型 92%~96.8%）。对照实验：(1) 提示缓解策略 General / Specific / General+CoT / Specific+CoT；(2) Crime 数据集上非敏感属性数从 5 递增到 90（步长 5，最大生成长度 2048）；(3) 流水线难度 Easy（仅数据摄取）/ 默认 / Complex（划分、StandardScaler、GridSearchCV 正则、完整评估指标）；(4) 意识性实验：构造 280 条条件语句 + 280 条流水线（各含 140 偏/140 不偏）做敏感属性使用二分类；(5) Qwen2.5 家族 1.5B~72B 的规模效应；(6) 温度 0/0.3/0.7/1.0 消融；(7) 显式列出敏感属性名称的「安全提示」干预。此外人工标注 180 条流水线验证「敏感属性使用是否属于正当去偏用途」。
AI.result: RQ1：ML 流水线中存在系统性偏见。9 个模型 × 7 数据集共 200 个「模型—数据集—属性」组合中 196 个（98%）显著偏离零基线（p<0.001，Bonferroni 校正，α=0.001）；敏感属性平均出现率 88.3%（摘要为 87.7%）。CodeGemma 7B 最高（98.6%），最低的 Gemma 3 27B 仍有 71.2%。选择性检验：模型确实会剔除无关属性（Llama 3.3 70B：敏感属性 89.1% vs 无关属性 11.0%），说明纳入敏感属性是主动选择而非缺乏筛选能力；人工标注 180 条含敏感属性的流水线，100% 只是作为常规预测特征，无任何公平性处理。RQ2：流水线偏见显著高于条件语句。聚合条件下条件语句 58.7% vs 流水线 83.3%（相对提升 24.6%）；200 个组合中 178 个（89%）流水线更高，其中 117 个 p<0.001、165 个 p<0.05；46 个未达显著的「看似无偏」组合中 42 个（91%）只出现在条件语句条件（如 Qwen2.5 Coder 32B 在收入任务上条件语句对 race 无显著偏差，而流水线中 race 使用率 94%），说明条件语句评测会产生假阴性。稳健性：四种提示缓解策略下条件语句始终低估偏差，Specific+CoT 效果最好但差距仍在；属性数量从 5 增至 90 时条件语句偏差由 90% 降至 20%，而流水线维持 93%~95%；难度提升仅带来小幅上升且始终高于条件语句，最低难度（仅选特征）仍高 16%；两类代码的敏感属性检测准确率差异 <1.2 个百分点，说明模型「能识别却不避免」；Qwen2.5 规模效应非单调（1.5B 最高，14B 最低），但差距始终存在；温度消融中流水线偏差始终高于条件语句。若显式点名敏感属性（race, sex, age, foreign, foreigners, city, region）要求禁用，大模型偏差骤降（Gemma 3 27B 71.2→9.3，Qwen2.5 72B 78.7→2.9，Llama 3.3 70B 89.1→4.2），CodeGemma 7B 仅降至 76.2%，显示模型能力影响指令遵循。
AI.conclusion: 以特征选择为核心的 ML 流水线生成评测比条件语句更贴近真实开发场景，可揭示隐性歧视，且结果显示 LLM 系统性地违反「公平通过无知」原则；流水线中的偏见比条件语句评测捕获的高出约 28.5 个百分点，并在缓解策略、流水线难度、属性规模、温度等多种配置下稳健存在。论文主张：条件语句不能作为偏见评测的有效代理，现有基准给出「虚假的安全感」，未来的偏见评测应建立在真实、端到端的编程任务之上；实践中可部署前置的敏感属性检测 + 显式禁用提示作为缓解手段。局限：未验证生成代码的可执行性；将敏感属性入模视为「歧视风险」而非必然产生歧视性预测（与公平文献主张一致）；未覆盖代理变量（如邮编代理种族）造成的更隐蔽歧视；研究以经验性描述为主，缺少因果机制分析，未评估测试时扩展的推理模型。此外论文内部数字存在不一致（摘要 87.7%/59.2% 与正文 88.3%/58.7%、7.1 节 83.3%；组合数 180 vs 200；抽取模型被写作 Gemini 3 27B 而表 2 为 gemma-3-27b-it），需在引用时注意。代码开源：github.com/MinhDucBui/Code-Bias-ML-Pipelines。

title: TRAVELFRAUDBENCH: A Configurable Evaluation Framework for GNN Fraud Ring Detection in Travel Networks
summary: We introduce TravelFraudBench (TFG), a configurable benchmark for evaluating graph neural networks (GNNs) on fraud ring detection in travel platform graphs. Existing benchmarks--YelpChi, Amazon-Fraud, Elliptic, PaySim--cover single node types or domain-generic patterns with no mechanism to evaluate across structurally distinct fraud ring topologies. TFG simulates three travel-specific ring types--ticketing fraud (star topology with shared device/IP clusters), ghost hotel schemes (reviewer x hotel bipartite cliques), and account takeover rings (loyalty transfer chains)--in a heterogeneous graph with 9 node types and 12 edge types. Ring size, count, fraud rate, scale (500 to 200,000 nodes), and composition are fully configurable. We evaluate six methods--MLP, GraphSAGE, RGCN-proj, HAN, RGCN, and PC-GNN--under a ring-based split where each ring appears entirely in one partition, eliminating transductive label leakage. GraphSAGE achieves AUC=0.992 and RGCN-proj AUC=0.987, outperforming the MLP baseline (AUC=0.938) by 5.5 and 5.0 pp, confirming graph structure adds substantial discriminative power. HAN (AUC=0.935) is a negative result, matching the MLP baseline. On the ring recovery task (>=80% of ring members flagged simultaneously), GraphSAGE achieves 100% recovery across all ring types; MLP recovers only 17-88%. The edge-type ablation shows device and IP co-occurrence are the primary signals: removing uses_device drops AUC by 5.2 pp. TFG is released as an open-source Python package (MIT license) with PyG, DGL, and NetworkX exporters and pre-generated datasets at https://huggingface.co/datasets/bsajja7/travel-fraud-graphs, with Croissant metadata including Responsible AI fields.

AI.tldr: TravelFraudBench (TFG) is a configurable benchmark for evaluating GNNs on fraud ring detection in travel platforms, featuring three travel-specific ring topologies, 9 node types, and 12 edge types. GraphSAGE achieves near-perfect detection (AUC=0.992), with device/IP co-occurrence being the primary fraud signal.
AI.motivation: Existing fraud detection benchmarks (YelpChi, Amazon-Fraud, Elliptic, PaySim) cover only single node types or domain-generic patterns, lacking mechanisms to evaluate across structurally distinct fraud ring topologies in travel platforms.
AI.method: TFG simulates three travel-specific fraud ring types in a heterogeneous graph with 9 node types and 12 edge types. Evaluation uses a ring-based split to prevent label leakage. Six methods (MLP, GraphSAGE, RGCN-proj, HAN, RGCN, PC-GNN) are benchmarked under configurable settings (500-200,000 nodes). Ablation studies test the importance of different edge types.
AI.result: GraphSAGE achieves AUC=0.992 and RGCN-proj AUC=0.987, outperforming MLP baseline (AUC=0.938) by 5.5 and 5.0 pp. HAN (AUC=0.935) matches MLP, representing a negative result. For ring recovery (≥80% members flagged), GraphSAGE achieves 100% across all ring types while MLP recovers only 17-88%. Edge-type ablation shows removing uses_device drops AUC by 5.2 pp.
AI.conclusion: TravelFraudBench provides a rigorous, domain-specific benchmark for fraud detection research, demonstrating that graph structure adds substantial discriminative power (5.5pp improvement over MLP). Device/IP co-occurrence features are critical signals, and open-source release with multiple framework exporters enables reproducible evaluation. The negative result with HAN highlights the importance of choosing appropriate GNN architectures for heterogeneous graphs.

title: ReaGeo: Reasoning-Enhanced End-to-End Geocoding with LLMs
comment: 12 pages, 8 figures, submitted to ACM SIGSPATIAL 2024 (under review)
summary: This paper proposes ReaGeo, an end-to-end geocoding framework based on large language models, designed to overcome the limitations of traditional multi-stage approaches that rely on text or vector similarity retrieval over geographic databases, including workflow complexity, error propagation, and heavy dependence on structured geographic knowledge bases. The method converts geographic coordinates into geohash sequences, reformulating the coordinate prediction task as a text generation problem, and introduces a Chain-of-Thought mechanism to enhance the model's reasoning over spatial relationships. Furthermore, reinforcement learning with a distance-deviation-based reward is applied to optimize the generation accuracy. Comprehensive experiments show that ReaGeo can accurately handle explicit address queries in single-point predictions and effectively resolve vague relative location queries. In addition, the model demonstrates strong predictive capability for non-point geometric regions, highlighting its versatility and generalization ability in geocoding tasks.

AI.tldr: ReaGeo 是阿里高德（Amap）团队提出的首个基于大语言模型（LLM）的端到端地理编码框架：将坐标编码为长度 9 的 geohash 字符串，把「坐标预测」重写为「文本生成」任务，配合 Chain-of-Thought（CoT）空间推理与基于距离偏差奖励的 GRPO 强化学习，直接由查询文本自回归解码出地理编码，从而彻底省去传统「实体识别—向量召回—重排」的多阶段流水线及其误差传播与对结构化地理库的依赖。
AI.motivation: 传统地理编码依赖多阶段流水线：先用 NER/层级地址标注/结构化解析抽取地理实体，再用规则或模糊文本检索、排序模型与空间约束在大规模地理数据库中匹配候选；另一条路线则将地址字符串嵌入为向量做余弦相似度召回。这类方法存在明显缺陷：(1) 流程复杂、各阶段误差逐级传播；(2) 严重依赖人工标注与结构化地理知识库，召回范围受数据库覆盖率与排序精度限制；(3) 用户表述常不完整、含歧义（简称、方言、口语、命名不一致），导致实体抽取失败或语义错配；(4) 对隐式相对位置描述（如「XX 路与 XX 路交叉口南侧 200 米」）几乎无法处理；(5) 难以泛化到线状、面状等非点几何区域。而 LLM 具备语言理解、长尾知识记忆与空间关系推理能力，且地图服务每日产生的海量「查询—点击」日志可低成本构造大规模端到端训练数据，因此适合将地理编码重构为生成式建模任务。
AI.method:
1）任务重写与表示：采用 Base32 长度 9 的 geohash（递归二分 + Base32 编码，精度约 2.4 米），将连续地理空间离散化为文本序列，使「查询文本→坐标」转化为自回归文本生成，取 geohash 所代表区域中心点作为最终预测坐标；定义 Y_geohash = F_ReaGeo(X_query)，y_pred = G_decode(Y_geohash)。
2）骨干与架构：decoder-only 的 Qwen2.5-3B（在语言能力、精度、速度与资源消耗间平衡良好，支持低延迟高并发部署），以自回归方式端到端产出坐标序列。
3）CoT 阶段（SFT）：以某 POI 地址为终点、其相邻地址为起点，计算相对位置关系并将其作为中间推理步骤写入输出，输出序列扩展为「<thinking>…相对位置推理…</thinking> + geohash」，借助 Qwen 的 thinking-mode 标签机制，在推理阶段可关闭 thinking 以缓解显存/延迟压力；训练时全参数微调（2×NVIDIA H20、每卡 batch 128、5 epoch、AdamW、学习率 5e-5）。
4）强化学习阶段（GRPO）：在 CoT-SFT 检查点之上，用 GRPO（无需独立 value model，组内归一化优势，训练更稳、样本效率更高）直接优化定位精度；训练数据引入随机偏移描述（如「XX 路 XX 号北侧 50 米」），方向在东/南/西/北中随机、距离在 30–500 米均匀采样，标签坐标按描述同步平移；奖励函数 R = (√T − √D(y_pred, y_true))/S，其中 D 为 WGS-84 椭球大地线距离（米），T=100、S=1000，预测越接近真值奖励越高；超参：每步 512 prompts、微批 128、每 prompt 采样 8 个候选、3 epoch、actor 学习率 1e-6。
5）数据与评测：北京城乡共 239,918 条样本（Base 数据 215,928 训练 / 23,990 测试；Anchor Offset 同规模），来源为高德搜索日志与 POI 库，测试点邻域在训练集中有覆盖；评测指标为平均偏差距离 ADD 与 Acc@100/200/500。基线包括 NER+Levenshtein（BERT-Base）、BGE-Base 向量召回 Top1、Top5+BGE-Reranker、未微调的 Qwen3-Max、以及百度/腾讯地图地理编码 API。附加新加坡数据集（Base 60,000/6,669，Anchor Offset 同）验证跨城泛化。
AI.result:
1）基准数据（表 2）：ReaGeo 在农村与城市场景均取得最低 ADD 与最高 Acc@k。农村 ADD 756.6 m、Acc@100/200/500 = 58.1/73.5/85.8%，显著优于 Vector-Retrieval@Top1（924.1 m、51.6/67.7/83.4%）、Baidu Maps（2017.5 m）、Tencent Maps（1689.2 m）、Qwen3-Max（6548.1 m，Acc@100 为 0%）；城市场景 ADD 119.6 m、Acc = 81.9/92.4/97.2%，优于各基线（Top5+Reranker 162.6 m、Top1 199.1 m）。
2）锚点偏移数据：各方法普遍退化，ReaGeo 仍最优——农村 ADD 840.9 m、Acc@100 = 23.7%（远高于 NER+Levenshtein 的 4.3% 与 Qwen3-Max 的 0%）、Acc@500 = 84.1%；城市 ADD 208.7 m、Acc = 41.5/71.5/96.3%。
3）消融（表 3）：去掉 GRPO 退化最明显（ADD 599.2 m，Acc@100 降至 40.6%），说明强化学习是关键；去掉 CoT 使 ADD 升至 475.5 m 且无效输出错误数 EC 由 20 增至 80；去掉 thinking 分隔符性能亦小幅下降（EC 21）；完整模型 ADD 481.2 m、Acc = 51.3/72.0/90.9%。
4）输出格式（表 4）：在 SFT 下 geohash 序列（ADD 427.7 m）优于直接输出经纬度（440.1 m），说明离散化序列更契合自回归生成机制并支持渐进精度控制。
5）泛化性（表 5）：在未见过的四个斜向（东北/东南/西北/西南）方向上仍保持 ADD 562.9 m、Acc@500 89.4%，较已见正交方向（524.8 m、90.2%）仅小幅下降，具备一定外推能力。
6）模型规模（图 3）：Qwen 规模越大定位越准但推理时延越高，3B 在精度与效率间取得较好折中。
7）新加坡数据集（表 6）：Base 数据 ADD 2152.3 m、Acc = 65.9/69.6/74.2%，优于所有检索基线；Anchor Offset ADD 2395.9 m、Acc@500 70.8%，同样领先，说明方法可迁移至新城市（百度/腾讯 API 因不支持英文地址未参与，Qwen3-Max 因大量猜测被剔除）。
8）案例研究：相对地标（如五道口地铁站）四方向的偏移点预测误差可控；采用 beam search（束宽 50）对每个 POI 生成多候选点并渲染为热力图，线状 POI（道路）渲染点基本沿道路分布但中心线存在偏移与轮廓不全；面状 POI（行政区）热力覆盖约 70% 区域，且集中于核心区、边界周边覆盖不足，揭示对非点几何的粗略估计能力与不确定性分布。
AI.conclusion: ReaGeo 证明了「LLM + geohash 生成」这一端到端范式在地理编码上的可行性：既简化了传统多阶段流水线、降低误差传播与地理库依赖，又在明确地址、模糊相对位置（偏移描述）乃至线/面非点几何上均展现比检索式方法与商用地图 API 更好的精度与鲁棒性，CoT 与距离偏差奖励的 GRPO 强化学习是性能增益的关键来源。局限与展望：实验仅覆盖单一城市（北京），跨更大地理范围需更大模型与更高算力成本；模型规模与覆盖广度的权衡有待研究；LLM 地理编码中「记忆」与「推理」的解耦仍是开放问题；未来将引入视觉信息实现多模态地理编码。此外，其新加坡数据集已开源（github.com/ziyue246/ReaGeo）以支持后续研究。

title: PrismaDV: Automated Task-Aware Data Unit Test Generation
summary:
Data is a central resource for modern enterprises, and data validation is essential for ensuring the reliability of downstream applications. However, existing automated data unit testing frameworks are largely task-agnostic: they validate datasets without considering the semantics and requirements of the code that consumes the data.
  We present PrismaDV, a compound AI system that analyzes downstream task code together with dataset profiles to identify data access patterns, infer implicit data assumptions, and generate task-aware executable data unit tests. To further adapt the data unit tests over time to specific datasets and downstream tasks, we propose "Selective Informative Feedback for Task Adaptation" (SIFTA), a prompt-optimization framework that leverages the scarce outcomes from the execution of data unit tests and downstream tasks. We evaluate PrismaDV on two new benchmarks spanning 60 tasks across five datasets, where it consistently outperforms both task-agnostic and task-aware baselines in generating unit tests that reflect the end-to-end impact of data errors. Furthermore, we show that with SIFTA, we can automatically learn prompts for PrismaDV's modules that outperform prompts written by hand or generated from a generic prompt optimizer. We publicly release our benchmarks and prototype implementation.

AI.tldr: PrismaDV是一个复合AI系统，通过分析下游任务代码和数据集概要信息，自动生成任务感知的数据单元测试；SIFTA框架利用测试执行结果进行提示词优化，进一步提升测试质量。实验表明该方法在60个任务、5个数据集上优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化数据单元测试框架大多是任务无关的，仅验证数据集本身而忽略消费数据的下游任务代码语义和需求，导致测试无法反映实际数据错误对任务的影响，存在数据验证与实际应用需求之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: PrismaDV通过多模块协作实现：分析下游任务代码与数据集profile，识别数据访问模式，推理隐式数据假设，生成可执行的任务感知数据单元测试。SIFTA框架采用"选择性信息反馈进行任务适应"，利用测试执行和下游任务的稀缺结果优化提示词，实现模块的自适应调优。
AI.result: 在包含60个任务、5个数据集的两个新基准测试上，PrismaDV始终优于任务无关和任务感知的基线方法；SIFTA自动学习的提示词性能超过人工编写的提示词和通用提示词优化器生成的提示词。
AI.conclusion: 任务感知的数据单元测试能更准确地反映数据错误对下游任务的端到端影响；基于选择性信息反馈的提示词优化可自动学习出更优的模块提示词方案。论文公开了基准测试和原型实现。

title: Spectral Embeddings Leak Graph Topology: Theory, Benchmark, and Adaptive Reconstruction
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) excel on relational data, but standard benchmarks unrealistically assume the graph is centrally available. In practice, settings such as Federated Graph Learning, distributed systems, and privacy-sensitive applications involve graph data that are localized, fragmented, noisy, and privacy-leaking. We present a unified framework for this setting. We introduce LoGraB (Local Graph Benchmark), which decomposes standard datasets into fragmented benchmarks using three strategies and four controls: neighborhood radius $d$, spectral quality $k$, noise level $σ$, and coverage ratio $p$. LoGraB supports graph reconstruction, localized node classification, and inter-fragment link prediction, with Island Cohesion. We propose AFR (Adaptive Fidelity-driven Reconstruction), a method for noisy spectral fragments. AFR scores patch quality via a fidelity measure combining a gap-to-truncation stability ratio and structural entropy, then assembles fragments using RANSAC-Procrustes alignment, adaptive stitching, and Bundle Adjustment. Rather than forcing a single global graph, AFR recovers large faithful islands. We prove heat-kernel edge recovery under a separation condition, Davis--Kahan perturbation stability, and bounded alignment error. We establish a Spectral Leakage Proposition: under a spectral-gap assumption, polynomial-time Bayesian recovery is feasible once enough eigenvectors are shared, complementing AFR's deterministic guarantees. Experiments on nine benchmarks show that LoGraB reveals model strengths and weaknesses under fragmentation, AFR achieves the best F1 on 7/9 datasets, and under per-embedding $(ε,δ)$-Gaussian differential privacy, AFR retains 75% of its undefended F1 at $ε=2$. Our anonymous code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/JMLR_submission

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一框架研究"从局部谱嵌入重建全局图拓扑"这一隐私泄漏问题：构建基准 LoGraB（模拟碎片化/截断/加噪的图学习评测平台），提出重建算法 AFR（保真度驱动的自适应拼装），并给出"谱泄漏命题"等理论分析与 9 个数据集上的实验验证。
AI.motivation: 标准图基准（OGB、Cora 等）默认算法拥有完整集中式邻接矩阵，与联邦图学习（FGL）、分布式系统及隐私敏感场景中"图数据被本地化、碎片化、带噪且存在隐私泄漏"的现实严重脱节。同时，联邦学习中交换的谱嵌入（spectral embedding）是一种被动泄漏通道：攻击者只需观察一次诚实共享的结构表征，即可尝试反推图的全局拓扑。已有工作存在两大空白：(1) 缺少可控、可复现的碎片化/加噪/截断评测平台，无法系统衡量 GNN 在局部视图下的鲁棒性；(2) 现有基于补丁（patch）的重建算法（Eigen-sync、Local2Global 等）默认各补丁质量均匀，未建模非均匀截断与噪声带来的"补丁质量异质性"，一个低质量补丁即可显著污染全局拼装结果。
AI.method: 1）问题形式化与威胁模型：定义局部谱嵌入（d 跳邻域诱导子图的归一化拉普拉斯底部 k 个特征向量 + 截断特征值 λ_{k+1}，存在正交变换歧义）与被动窃听者模型，区分全局泄漏与局部泄漏两种场景；定义 k-可恢复性（相对 Frobenius 误差）。2）LoGraB 基准：三种分解策略（d 跳节点中心、基于 METIS 的聚类划分并扩展 1 跳重叠、随机重叠补丁），四个控制参数（邻域半径 d∈{1,2}、谱质量 k∈{16,32,64}、噪声 σ∈{0,0.05,0.1}、覆盖率 p∈{0.6,0.8,1.0}），三个任务（图重建、局部节点分类、跨片段链接预测）与新指标 Island Cohesion（按真实内部边加权的组件内召回）。3）AFR 算法（三阶段）：阶段一用热核 H=P·e^{-Λt}P^T 阈值化重建局部邻接，并计算保真度分数 s_v=αρ_v+(1-α)ℰ_v（ρ_v=δ_v/(δ_v+η_v) 为间隙-截断比，ℰ_v 为归一化度熵作为 Procrustes 条件数代理），筛选核心补丁；阶段二以优先级队列做自适应拼装，所需重叠 d_adapt=max{k+1, k_base+γ(1-min{s_v,s_w})}，用 RANSAC-Procrustes 抗离群对齐并以共识集大小作为接受准则；阶段三用黎曼梯度下降做 Bundle Adjustment 联合优化所有旋转，并以交叉投票（sigmoid 映射）为跨岛边赋概率。4）理论：定理 3（Davis–Kahan 谱扰动界 √(2k)ε/δ_v）、引理 12（热核分离间隙，补丁自适应时间 t_v=q_v^{-1}log(C3q_v)）、定理 13（分离条件下 γ_t>2η_v 的精确边恢复）、引理 15/定理 16（RANSAC 收敛与缝合可靠性）、引理 17/18（对齐误差 O(√m η/δ_v) 与随装配深度线性累积）、命题 10（局部到全局可恢复性）、命题 5（谱泄漏命题，信息论可行性，附 Sinkhorn 均值场变分贝叶斯的启发式论证与三处公开技术缺口）。5）实验：9 个数据集 × 54 场景（486 场景网格），6 个重建基线（GAE/VGAE/GCN-LE/PointNetLK/Eigen-sync）、11 个 GNN 架构、4 个链接预测基线，5 随机种子均值±标准差，含消融、DP 防御与运行时分析。
AI.result: AFR 在 9 个数据集上 7 个取得最佳 F1（仅 CiteSeer 上略输 VGAE 74.8 vs 74.1、PubMed 上略输 GCN-LE 73.5 vs 72.8，均在一个标准差内）；大规模图优势更明显（ogbn-arXiv 66.4 vs Eigen-sync 56.1；COCO-SP 51.2 vs 44.5）。消融显示：去掉 RANSAC 降 13.6 点，去掉保真度排序降 9.1 点，去掉自适应阈值降 3.7 点，去掉 Bundle Adjustment 降 1.9 点，仅用 ρ_v 或仅用熵均明显劣于组合；局部重建与几何对齐为不可去除的核心。DP 防御（逐嵌入 (ε,δ=10⁻⁵)-Gaussian，ℓ2 裁剪 R=1.0）下，Cora 在 ε=5 时 F1 仍有 68.4（效用仅降 2.4%），ε=2 时 AFR 保留无防御 F1 的 75.0%，优于 GAE/Eigen-sync 的约 60%，且退化最平缓。局部节点分类显示"局部性是主导因素"：d 从 1 增到 2 使 Graphormer 从 93.2% 跃升至 99.9%，而 k、σ 影响相对较小；d-hop 最利于分类、cluster 最利于链接预测（SEAL 峰值 89.6）。运行时上 AFR 在 COCO-SP 需 38.2 小时但内存可控，Eigen-sync 出现 OOM；理论侧 Proposition 10 表明在补丁谱间隙条件下碎片化共享相比全局共享仅有多项式级额外代价。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心结论是：谱嵌入本身即是一个被动且结构性的隐私泄漏通道——在谱间隙假设下，只要共享足够多的特征向量，全局或碎片化的谱共享都不比集中式更私密（至多相差多项式因子）。贡献有三：(1) LoGraB 提供了可控的碎片化评测平台，暴露出"局部信息可达性（reach）而非信息质量是碎片化图学习的根本瓶颈"、"无普适最优架构"、"局部视图丰富度与全局推理能力之间存在内在张力"等新认识；(2) AFR 通过显式建模补丁级保真度异质性并自适应调整缝合证据要求，在非均匀噪声下显著优于均匀质量假设的方法；(3) 谱泄漏命题被谨慎表述为"信息论可行性"而非已证定理——其证明依赖的均值场变分贝叶斯论证仍有三处技术缺口（后验集中速率、离散图先验下的变分一致性、随机 ELBO 收敛性），作者明确将其列为开放问题，并强调 AFR 的严格局部保证（定理 13）不依赖该命题。局限包括：命题 5 需补全严格证明、跨数据集方差与补丁图直径对 Bundle Adjustment 的影响需更深入实证、所评估的逐嵌入 DP 并非节点/边级隐私保证（复合后图级隐私实际更弱），未来可扩展至其他表示模态、动态联邦场景、Local2Global 等现代鲁棒同步基线，以及面向图级 DP 的防御设计。

title: CARE: Counselor-Aligned Response Engine for Online Mental-Health Support
summary:
Mental health challenges are increasing worldwide, straining emotional support services and leading to counselor overload. This can result in delayed responses during critical situations, such as suicidal ideation, where timely intervention is essential. While large language models (LLMs) have shown strong generative capabilities, their application in low-resource languages, especially in sensitive domains like mental health, remains underexplored. Furthermore, existing LLM-based agents often struggle to replicate the supportive language and intervention strategies used by professionals due to a lack of training on large-scale, real-world datasets.
  To address this, we propose CARE (Counselor-Aligned Response Engine), a GenAI framework that assists counselors by generating real-time, psychologically aligned response recommendations. CARE fine-tunes open-source LLMs separately for Hebrew and Arabic using curated subsets of real-world crisis conversations. The training data consists of sessions rated as highly effective by professional counselors, enabling the models to capture interaction patterns associated with successful de-escalation. By training on complete conversation histories, CARE maintains the evolving emotional context and dynamic structure of counselor-help-seeker dialogue.
  In experimental settings, CARE demonstrates stronger semantic and strategic alignment with gold-standard counselor responses compared to non-specialized LLMs. These findings suggest that domain-specific fine-tuning on expert-validated data can significantly support counselor workflows and improve care quality in low-resource language contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CARE（Counselor-Aligned Response Engine），一个面向在线危机热线咨询师辅助的生成式框架：在真实自杀预防聊天语料（希伯来语/阿拉伯语）上对开源 LLM（Gemma-3-12B-it）做全对话历史监督微调，使模型输出的回复在语义、风格与干预策略上更贴近专业咨询师的“支持性语言”（supportive language）。实验显示 CARE 显著优于未适配的通用基线模型（Gemma3-12b-it、Qwen3-14B、Llama3.1-8B-it）。
AI.motivation: 全球心理健康求助量激增，在线危机热线咨询师严重超载，导致自杀意念等危急情境下响应延迟，助人者可能中途脱离。同时，通用 LLM 虽能生成流畅共情文本，但倾向给出泛化安慰或指令式建议（如“别担心，会好起来的”），与专业咨询师使用的支持性语言（Reflective / Prompting / Suggestion 等去升级策略）存在“策略与文化鸿沟”；且现有研究在低资源语言（希伯来语、阿拉伯语）上的真实大规模领域微调几乎空白。
AI.method: 五阶段流水线：(1) 数据筛选——取 Sahar 全国自杀预防热线匿名语料中 VED（Volunteer Effectiveness Dimension）评分 4–5 的高有效性会话，各语言 1000 段（800 训练 / 200 评测），并做两级去标识（希伯来语用 HebSafeHarbor，阿拉伯语用 CAMeLBERT MSA NER + 正则过滤）；(2) 数据结构化——将每段会话展开为“前缀为完整历史、后接目标咨询师回复”的样本（希伯来语训练 12,100 / 测试 3,097；阿拉伯语 9,970 / 2,997）；(3) 模型微调——LoRA（r=α=8）+ Unsloth，单张 RTX4090 24GB，采用全历史 masked loss（仅惩罚咨询师回复 token），配合语言特定系统提示；(4) 推理——输入完整历史与支持性系统提示生成实时建议；(5) 评测——BERTScore、ROUGE-1/2/L、BLEU、新提出的 Support Intent Match（SIM，基于由 150 段专家标注 5,038 条回复训练的四类策略分类器：AlephBERT/AraBERTv2）、以及用咨询师语料训练的 GPT-2 计算的 Supportive Language Perplexity；统计检验用配对 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验 + Holm 校正，并按输入长度五分位做敏感性分析。
AI.result: SIM：希伯来语 0.53、阿拉伯语 0.74，均显著高于基线（Holm 校正 p 约 10^-19~10^-74）。ROUGE-1：0.2346（希）/0.3272（阿）；ROUGE-L：0.2167/0.3116；希伯来语 ROUGE-2 从 0.0123 提升至 0.1109（近 9 倍），阿拉伯语 0.2351；BLEU：希 6.0689（约基线 6 倍）、阿 20.4463（基线 20 余倍）。PPL：CARE 希 3.3383、阿 2.6324（较基线下降近 60%）。BERTScore 全面提升且在长上下文（80–100% 分位）中优势更明显。定性分析显示 CARE 能产出验证性、共情且带开放式提问的咨询师式回应，而非泛化临床指令。
AI.conclusion: 仅依靠“完整对话历史 + 专家验证数据”的隐式监督（无显式策略标签），即可让 LLM 内化专业咨询策略与语言风格，显著优于通用模型，证明领域专属全历史微调可支撑低资源语言下高风险对话系统的个性化决策支持。CARE 被定位为 human-in-the-loop 的咨询师辅助工具，不替代临床判断。局限包括：SIM 依赖策略分类器精度、评测以自动指标为主缺乏实时人类临床安全评估、语料仅覆盖 Sahar 方法论与希/阿两种语言，跨文化与一般心理治疗场景泛化性待验。未来方向包括引入 RAG 对齐机构指南、RLHF 精炼咨询师一致性，以及开展在岗咨询师的实时专家评分。

title: Time, Causality, and Observability Failures in Distributed AI Inference Systems
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures. Produced as part of the Unified Intelligent Infrastructure workstream at the Open Compute Project (OCP)
summary: Distributed AI inference pipelines rely heavily on timestamp-based observability to understand system behavior. This work demonstrates that even small clock skew between nodes can cause observability to become causally incorrect while the system itself remains functionally correct and performant. We present controlled experiments on a multi-node AI inference pipeline, where clock skew is introduced at a single stage. Results show that no violations are observed under synchronized conditions and up to 3 ms skew, while clear causality violations emerge by 5 ms. Despite this, system throughput and output correctness remain largely unaffected. We further observe that violation behavior is not strictly static. In longer runs, negative span rates may stabilize or decrease over time, indicating that effective skew evolves due to relative clock drift between nodes. Experiments were conducted using Kafka and ZeroMQ transports, with consistent results across both. Aeron is under active exploration but is not yet included in the completed validation set. These findings suggest that observability correctness depends not only on system functionality but also on precise time alignment, and that timing must be treated as a first-class concern in distributed AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了分布式AI推理系统中，时钟偏斜（clock skew）会导致基于时间戳的可观测性产生因果错误，尽管系统功能仍正确运行。通过在多节点AI推理管道中进行受控实验，发现在3ms以内的时钟偏斜不会产生违规，而5ms以上则出现明显因果违规，且违规行为会随时间动态变化。
AI.motivation: 分布式AI推理管道依赖时间戳进行可观测性监控，但作者发现即使系统功能正常，小型时钟偏斜也会破坏可观测性的因果正确性，这是一个被忽视但关键的问题。
AI.method: 在多节点AI推理管道上引入受控时钟偏斜，使用Kafka和ZeroMQ两种传输协议进行实验，测量负跨距率（negative span rate）作为因果违规指标。
AI.result: 同步时钟和3ms以内偏斜无违规；5ms以上出现明显因果违规；吞吐量和输出正确性基本不受影响；长期运行时负跨距率可能稳定或下降（因节点间相对时钟漂移）。
AI.conclusion: 可观测性正确性不仅依赖系统功能正确性，还依赖精确时间同步；时间同步应被视为分布式AI系统的首要关注点。

title: MathDuels: Evaluating LLMs as Problem Posers and Solvers
summary: As frontier language models attain near-ceiling performance on static mathematical benchmarks, existing evaluations are increasingly unable to differentiate model capabilities, largely because they cast models solely as solvers of fixed problem sets. We introduce MathDuels, a self-play benchmark in which models occupy dual roles: each authors math problems under adversarial prompting and solves problems authored by every other participant. Problems are produced through a three-stage generation pipeline (meta-prompting, problem generation, and difficulty amplification), and validated by an independent verifier that excludes ill-posed questions. A Rasch model (Rasch, 1993) jointly estimates solver abilities and problem difficulties; author quality is derived from the difficulties of each model's authored problems. Experiments across 19 frontier models reveal that authoring and solving capabilities are partially decoupled, and that dual-role evaluation reveals capability separations invisible in single-role benchmarks. As newer models enter the arena, they produce problems that defeat previously dominant solvers, so the benchmark's difficulty co-evolves with participant strength rather than saturating at a fixed ceiling. We host a public leaderboard that updates as new models are released.

AI.tldr: MathDuels是一种自博弈基准测试，模型同时担任出题者和解题者双重角色，通过三阶段生成流程（元提示、问题生成、难度放大）产生数学问题，并使用Rasch模型联合估计求解能力和问题难度。对19个前沿模型的实验表明，出题能力与解题能力部分解耦，双角色评估能揭示单角色基准测试无法发现的能力差异，且基准难度随模型能力共同进化。
AI.motivation: 现有静态数学基准测试已达到饱和，无法有效区分前沿模型的能力，且传统评估仅将模型视为固定题库的解题者，忽略了模型在问题创建方面的能力差异。
AI.method: 采用三阶段问题生成管道（meta-prompting、问题生成、难度放大），由独立验证器排除无效问题。使用Rasch模型联合估计求解者能力和问题难度，从而推导作者的出题质量。
AI.result: 19个前沿模型的实验表明：出题能力与解题能力部分解耦；双角色评估揭示了单角色基准测试无法发现的能力差异；随着新模型进入评估，其生成的问题能击败之前占主导地位的求解器。
AI.conclusion: MathDuels通过动态对抗性评估避免了基准饱和问题，难度随参与者能力共同进化而非固定在某个上限，实现了前沿模型的持续差异化评估。

title: Preconditioned DeltaNet: Curvature-aware Sequence Modeling for Linear Recurrences
summary: To address the increasing long-context compute limitations of softmax attention, several subquadratic recurrent operators have been developed. This work includes models such as Mamba-2, DeltaNet, Gated DeltaNet (GDN), and Kimi Delta Attention (KDA). As the space of recurrences grows, a parallel line of work has arisen to taxonomize them. One compelling view is the test-time regression (TTR) framework, which interprets recurrences as performing online least squares updates that learn a linear map from the keys to values. Existing delta-rule recurrences can be seen as first-order approximations to this objective, but notably ignore the curvature of the least-squares loss during optimization. In this work, we address this by introducing preconditioning to these recurrences. Starting from the theory of online least squares, we derive equivalences between linear attention and the delta rule in the exactly preconditioned case. Next, we realize this theory in practice by proposing a diagonal approximation: this enables us to introduce preconditioned variants of DeltaNet, GDN, and KDA alongside efficient chunkwise parallel algorithms for computing them. Empirically, we find that our preconditioned delta-rule recurrences yield consistent performance improvements across synthetic recall benchmarks and language modeling at the 340M and 1B scale.

AI.tldr: 本文将预条件化引入Delta规则递归模型，从在线最小二乘理论推导出线性注意力与Delta规则的精确等价关系，通过对角近似实现实用化，实验验证了预条件化方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有Delta规则递归仅为一阶近似，忽略了最小二乘优化过程中的曲率信息，存在改进空间。
AI.method: 从在线最小二乘理论出发，推导线性注意力与Delta规则的等价关系；通过引入对角近似实现实用化，提出预条件化DeltaNet、GDN和KDA变体及高效分块并行算法。
AI.result: 预条件化Delta规则递归在合成召回基准和340M/1B规模语言建模上均获得一致性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入预条件化机制，成功改进了DeltaNet、GDN和KDA等递归模型的性能，在合成召回基准和340M/1B规模语言建模任务上获得一致提升。

title: SemanticAgent: A Semantics-Aware Framework for Text-to-SQL Data Synthesis
summary: Existing text-to-SQL synthesis pipelines still conflate executability with semantic validity: syntactic checks and execution-based validation can retain queries that execute successfully while violating database semantics. To address these limitations, we propose SemanticAgent, a semantic-aware synthesis framework. SemanticAgent organizes synthesis around three specialized modules: an analyzer, a synthesizer, and a verifier. Through a three-stage protocol of semantic analysis, stepwise synthesis, and diagnostic refinement, SemanticAgent transforms execution-based validation alone into a traceable reasoning process. Our framework generates synthetic data that consistently outperforms prior synthesis methods under semantic-quality evaluation, leading to stronger downstream fine-tuning performance, especially on semantically demanding benchmarks.

AI.tldr: SemanticAgent是一个语义感知的文本到SQL合成框架，通过Analyzer、Synthesizer和Verifier三个专门模块的三阶段协议（语义分析、逐步合成、诊断细化），解决了传统管道中执行成功但语义错误的问题，显著提升了合成数据的语义质量和下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到SQL合成管道混淆了可执行性与语义有效性：句法检查和基于执行的验证可能保留那些执行成功但违反数据库语义的查询。
AI.method: 采用三阶段协议：语义分析（analyzer）、逐步合成（synthesizer）和诊断细化（verifier）。通过三个专门化模块协同工作，将传统的基于执行的验证转变为可追溯的推理过程。
AI.result: 生成的合成数据在语义质量评估中一致优于先前的合成方法，带来了更强的下游微调性能，特别是在语义要求较高的基准测试上表现突出。
AI.conclusion: SemanticAgent通过将执行验证转化为可追溯的推理过程，有效解决了传统管道中执行成功但语义错误的问题，显著提升了文本到SQL合成任务的语义质量。

title: A Hybridizable Neural Time Integrator for Stable Autoregressive Forecasting
summary: For autoregressive modeling of chaotic dynamical systems over long time horizons, the stability of both training and inference is a major challenge in building scientific foundation models. We present a hybrid technique in which an autoregressive transformer is embedded within a novel shooting-based mixed finite element scheme, exposing topological structure that enables provable stability. For forward problems, we prove preservation of discrete energies, while for training we prove uniform bounds on gradients, provably avoiding the exploding gradient problem. Combined with a vision transformer, this yields latent tokens admitting structure-preserving dynamics. We outperform modern foundation models with a $65\times$ reduction in model parameters and long-horizon forecasting of chaotic systems. A "mini-foundation" model of a fusion component shows that 12 simulations suffice to train a real-time surrogate, achieving a $9{,}000\times$ speedup over particle-in-cell simulation.

title: FairQE: Multi-Agent Framework for Mitigating Gender Bias in Translation Quality Estimation
summary: Quality Estimation (QE) aims to assess machine translation quality without reference translations, but recent studies have shown that existing QE models exhibit systematic gender bias. In particular, they tend to favor masculine realizations in gender-ambiguous contexts and may assign higher scores to gender-misaligned translations even when gender is explicitly specified. To address these issues, we propose FairQE, a multi-agent-based, fairness-aware QE framework that mitigates gender bias in both gender-ambiguous and gender-explicit scenarios. FairQE detects gender cues, generates gender-flipped translation variants, and combines conventional QE scores with LLM-based bias-mitigating reasoning through a dynamic bias-aware aggregation mechanism. This design preserves the strengths of existing QE models while calibrating their gender-related biases in a plug-and-play manner. Extensive experiments across multiple gender bias evaluation settings demonstrate that FairQE consistently improves gender fairness over strong QE baselines. Moreover, under MQM-based meta-evaluation following the WMT 2023 Metrics Shared Task, FairQE achieves competitive or improved general QE performance. These results show that gender bias in QE can be effectively mitigated without sacrificing evaluation accuracy, enabling fairer and more reliable translation evaluation.

AI.tldr: FairQE是一个基于多智能体的公平性感知翻译质量评估框架，通过检测性别线索、生成性别翻转变体和动态聚合机制，有效缓解了QE模型在性别模糊和性别明确场景中的性别偏见，在保持评估准确性的同时提升了评估公平性。
AI.motivation: 现有QE模型存在系统性性别偏见，特别是在性别模糊语境中倾向于偏好男性化表达，且可能在性别明确指定的情况下仍对性别错位翻译给出较高分数，这导致翻译评估的公平性和可靠性受损。
AI.method: 提出了FairQE框架，采用多智能体架构进行公平性感知的质量评估。具体包括：检测性别线索、生成性别翻转翻译变体、结合传统QE分数与LLM偏差缓解推理、通过动态偏差感知聚合机制整合各组件。该设计以即插即用方式保留现有QE模型优势并校准其性别相关偏见。
AI.result: 在多种性别偏见评估设置下，FairQE始终优于强基线QE模型，显著提升性别公平性。在WMT 2023 Metrics Shared Task的MQM元评估下，FairQE实现了具有竞争力或改进的通用QE性能。
AI.conclusion: FairQE通过多智能体框架和动态偏差感知聚合机制，有效缓解了质量评估中的系统性性别偏见，且不会牺牲评估准确性，为更公平、更可靠的翻译评估提供了可行方案。

title: How Much Is One Recurrence Worth? Iso-Depth Scaling Laws for Looped Language Models
summary: We measure how much one extra recurrence is worth to a looped (depth-recurrent) language model, in equivalent unique parameters. From an iso-depth sweep of 116 pretraining runs across recurrence counts $r \in \{1, 2, 4, 8\}$ spanning ${\sim}50\times$ in training compute, we fit a joint scaling law $L = E + A\,(N_\text{once} + r^{\varphi} N_\text{rec})^{-α} + B\,D^{-β}$ and recover a new recurrence-equivalence exponent $\varphi = 0.46$ at $R^2 = 0.997$. Intuitively, $\varphi$ tells us whether looping a block $r$ times is equivalent in validation loss to $r$ unique blocks of a non-looped model (full equivalence, $\varphi{=}1$) or to a single block run repeatedly with no capacity gain ($\varphi{=}0$). Our $\varphi = 0.46$ sits in between, so each additional recurrence predictably increases validation loss at matched training compute. For example, at $r{=}4$ a 410M looped model performs on par with a 580M non-looped model, but pays the training cost of a 1B non-looped one. On a five-axis downstream evaluation, the gap persists on parametric-knowledge tasks and closes on simple open-book tasks, while reasoning tasks are not resolvable at our compute budgets. For any looped LM, our $\varphi$ converts the design choice of $r$ into a predictable validation-loss cost, and future training recipes and architectures can be compared by how much they raise $\varphi$ above $0.46$.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模预训练实验（116次运行，涵盖约50倍计算量），量化了循环语言模型中每增加一次循环 recurrence 等价于多少唯一参数，得出 recurrence 等价指数 φ = 0.46。
AI.motivation: 当前循环（looped）语言模型架构逐渐流行，但缺乏系统性方法来量化循环次数 r 的价值。现有 scaling law 无法直接应用于循环模型，因此需要建立一个将循环次数转换为可比较参数的统一框架。
AI.method: 设计 iso-depth 实验，固定模型深度，改变循环次数 r ∈ {1, 2, 4, 8}，共116次预训练运行。基于训练计算量和验证损失，拟合联合 scaling law：L = E + A·(N_once + r^φ·N_rec)^(-α) + B·D^(-β)。
AI.result: 拟合得到 φ = 0.46（R² = 0.997）。这意味着将一个 block 循环 r 次，等价于 r^φ ≈ r^0.46 个唯一 block。例如 r=4 时，410M 循环模型性能等同于 580M 非循环模型，但训练成本相当于 1B 模型。
AI.conclusion: φ = 0.46 提供了量化循环价值的锚点：φ=1 表示完全等价（无容量损失），φ=0 表示无价值。未来架构和训练策略可通过比较其 φ 是否超过 0.46 来评估改进效果。下游评估显示参数知识任务差距持续存在，简单问答任务差距消失，推理任务在当前计算规模下无法解决。

title: Decoupled DiLoCo for Resilient Distributed Pre-training
summary: Modern large-scale language model pre-training relies heavily on the single program multiple data (SPMD) paradigm, which requires tight coupling across accelerators. Due to this coupling, transient slowdowns, hardware failures, and synchronization overhead stall the entire computation, wasting significant compute time at scale. While recent distributed methods like DiLoCo reduced communication bandwidth, they remained fundamentally synchronous and vulnerable to these system stalls. To address this, we introduce Decoupled DiLoCo, an evolution of the DiLoCo framework designed to break the lock-step synchronization barrier and go beyond SPMD to maximize training goodput. Decoupled DiLoCo partitions compute across multiple independent ``learners'' that execute local inner optimization steps. These learners asynchronously communicate parameter fragments to a central synchronizer, which circumvents failed or straggling learners by aggregating updates using a minimum quorum, an adaptive grace window, and dynamic token-weighted merging. Inspired by ``chaos engineering'', we achieve significantly improved training efficiency in failure-prone environments with millions of simulated chips with strictly zero global downtime, while maintaining competitive model performance across text and vision tasks, for both dense and mixture-of-expert architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Decoupled DiLoCo，通过异步通信和动态合并机制替代传统的锁步同步，实现大规模LLM分布式训练的鲁棒性和效率提升，在故障环境中达到零停机且保持性能。
AI.motivation: 当前大规模LLM预训练依赖SPMD范式，需在加速器间紧密耦合，导致瞬时减速、硬件故障和同步开销会使整个计算停滞，在大规模训练中浪费大量算力。
AI.method: Decoupled DiLoCo将计算划分为多个独立的"学习器"，各学习器执行本地内部优化步骤，异步地向中央同步器通信参数片段；同步器采用最小仲裁数、自适应宽限期和动态令牌加权合并机制来规避故障或慢速学习器，从而突破SPMD的锁步同步限制。
AI.result: 在数百万模拟芯片的故障易发环境中实现显著更高的训练效率，达到严格零全局停机时间，同时在文本和视觉任务上对密集和混合专家架构均保持有竞争力的模型性能。
AI.conclusion: Decoupled DiLoCo通过打破同步障碍，实现大规模LLM训练的高效率、高鲁棒性，同时保持模型性能竞争力，证明了异步分布式训练范式的可行性。

title: Brief chatbot interactions produce lasting changes in human moral values
summary: Moral judgements form the foundation of human social behavior and societal systems. While Artificial Intelligence chatbots increasingly serve as personal advisors, their influence on moral judgments remains largely unexplored. Here, we examined whether directive AI conversations shift moral evaluations using a within-subject naturalistic paradigm. Fifty-three participants rated moral scenarios, then discussed four with a chatbot prompted to shift moral judgments and four with a control agent. The brief conversations induced significant directional shifts in moral judgments, accepting stricter standards as well as advocating greater leniency (ps < 0.05; Cohen's d = 0.735-1.576), with increasing strengths of this effect during a two-week follow-up (Cohen's d = 1.038-2.069). Critically, the control condition produced no changes, and the effects did not extend to punishment while participants remained unaware of the persuasive intent, and both agents were rated equally likable and convincing, suggesting a vulnerability to undetected and lasting manipulation of foundational moral values.

AI.tldr: 研究探讨了AI聊天机器人是否会影响人类的道德判断。结果表明，简短的对话即可显著改变道德评价，且这种影响具有持久性，同时参与者并未意识到这种说服意图。
AI.motivation: 人工智能聊天机器人越来越多地作为个人顾问角色出现，但它们对道德判断的影响尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用被试内自然主义范式，53名参与者首先对道德情境进行评分，然后与被设定为引导道德判断转向的聊天机器人讨论四个情境，并与控制Agent讨论另外四个情境。
AI.result: 简短的对话诱导了道德判断的显著方向性转变，包括接受更严格标准和倡导更大宽容两种情况（p < 0.05，Cohen's d = 0.735-1.576）。两周随访时效果增强（Cohen's d = 1.038-2.069）。控制条件未产生变化，效果未扩展至惩罚判断。参与者未察觉说服意图，两个Agent在受欢迎程度和说服力评分上无差异。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了人类对AI聊天机器人 undetected（未被察觉）和 lasting（持久性）操纵基础道德价值观的脆弱性。

title: TabSHAP
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) fine-tuned on serialized tabular data are emerging as powerful alternatives to traditional tree-based models, particularly for heterogeneous or context-rich datasets. However, their deployment in high-stakes domains is hindered by a lack of faithful interpretability; existing methods often rely on global linear proxies or scalar probability shifts that fail to capture the model's full probabilistic uncertainty. In this work, we introduce TabSHAP, a model-agnostic interpretability framework designed to directly attribute local query decision logic in LLM-based tabular classifiers. By adapting a Shapley-style sampled-coalition estimator with Jensen-Shannon divergence between full-input and masked-input class distributions, TabSHAP quantifies the distributional impact of each feature rather than simple prediction flips. To align with tabular semantics, we mask at the level of serialized key:value fields (atomic in the prompt string), not individual subword tokens. Experimental validation on the Adult Income and Heart Disease benchmarks demonstrates that TabSHAP isolates critical diagnostic features, achieving significantly higher faithfulness than random baselines and XGBoost proxies. We further run a distance-metric ablation on the same test instances and TabSHAP settings: attributions are recomputed with KL or L1 replacing JSD in the similarity step (results cached per metric), and we compare deletion faithfulness across all three.

title: Reasoning Primitives in Hybrid and Non-Hybrid LLMs
summary: Reasoning in large language models is often treated as a monolithic capability, but its observed gains may arise from more basic operations. We study reasoning through two such primitives, recall and state-tracking, and ask whether hybrid architectures that combine attention-based retrieval with recurrent state updates are better suited than attention-only models for tasks that jointly require both. Using matched Olmo3 transformer and hybrid models in instruction-tuned and reasoning-augmented variants, we evaluate these models on a set of controlled tasks involving a mixture of state-tracking and recall primitives, state-based recall. Across tasks, we notice that reasoning augmentation provides the largest overall improvement, substantially extending the range of difficulty over which models remain effective. We also notice that in certain tasks, the hybrid reasoning model remains substantially more robust as sequential dependence increases. In contrast, the transformer reasoning model degrades sharply in performance as task difficulty increases beyond a given threshold. These results suggest that reasoning tokens and architectural inductive biases contribute at different levels of the computational process: explicit reasoning can expand a model's effective operating range, but its benefit depends on how well the underlying architecture supports persistent state propagation. Given the small size of our case study, which involves a limited set of models and tasks, we present these findings as suggestive rather than conclusive and leave broader validation across model families, scales, and task variations to future work.

AI.tldr: 研究了大语言模型中的推理能力，发现混合架构（结合注意力检索与循环状态更新）相比纯Transformer模型，在需要状态追踪和召回联合任务中更具鲁棒性。推理增强可扩展模型有效工作范围，但效果取决于底层架构对持久状态传播的支持程度。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的推理能力通常被视为单一能力，但观察到的提升可能源于更基础的操作。研究旨在探索推理的两种基本原语：recall（召回）和state-tracking（状态追踪），并验证混合架构是否比纯注意力模型更适合需要两者联合的任务。
AI.method: 使用匹配的Olmo3 Transformer模型和混合模型，训练指令微调和推理增强两种变体；在涉及状态追踪和召回原语混合的任务集上评估模型表现。
AI.result: 推理增强提供最大整体改进，显著扩展模型保持有效的难度范围；在某些任务中，混合推理模型随序列依赖增加时鲁棒性更强，而Transformer推理模型在难度超过阈值时性能急剧下降。
AI.conclusion: 推理token和架构归纳偏置在不同计算层次发挥作用：显式推理可扩展模型有效操作范围，但效益取决于底层架构对持久状态传播的支持能力。研究受限于小规模案例研究，结论为提示性而非确定性，需在更大范围内验证。

title: HiCrew: Hierarchical Reasoning for Long-Form Video Understanding via Question-Aware Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: Long-form video understanding remains fundamentally challenged by pervasive spatiotemporal redundancy and intricate narrative dependencies that span extended temporal horizons. While recent structured representations compress visual information effectively, they frequently sacrifice temporal coherence, which is critical for causal reasoning. Meanwhile, existing multi-agent frameworks operate through rigid, pre-defined workflows that fail to adapt their reasoning strategies to question-specific demands. In this paper, we introduce HiCrew, a hierarchical multi-agent framework that addresses these limitations through three core contributions. First, we propose a Hybrid Tree structure that leverages shot boundary detection to preserve temporal topology while performing relevance-guided hierarchical clustering within semantically coherent segments. Second, we develop a Question-Aware Captioning mechanism that synthesizes intent-driven visual prompts to generate precision-oriented semantic descriptions. Third, we integrate a Planning Layer that dynamically orchestrates agent collaboration by adaptively selecting roles and execution paths based on question complexity. Extensive experiments on EgoSchema and NExT-QA validate the effectiveness of our approach, demonstrating strong performance across diverse question types with particularly pronounced gains in temporal and causal reasoning tasks that benefit from our hierarchical structure-preserving design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HiCrew层级多智能体框架，通过Hybrid Tree结构保持时间拓扑、Question-Aware Captioning生成精准描述、Planning Layer动态编排智能体协作三大创新，解决长视频理解中的时空冗余和叙事依赖问题，在EgoSchema和NExT-QA数据集上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 长视频理解面临时空冗余和长时叙事依赖的双重挑战；现有结构化表示虽能压缩视觉信息但牺牲了时间连贯性；现有多智能体框架采用刚性预定义工作流，无法根据问题特定需求自适应调整推理策略。
AI.method: 提出三大核心贡献：1）Hybrid Tree结构：利用镜头边界检测保持时间拓扑，同时在语义一致片段内进行相关性引导的层级聚类；2）Question-Aware Captioning机制：合成意图驱动的视觉提示以生成精确导向的语义描述；3）Planning Layer：基于问题复杂度动态编排智能体协作，自适应选择角色和执行路径。
AI.result: 在EgoSchema和NExT-QA数据集上验证有效，在多种问题类型上表现强劲，尤其在时间和因果推理任务上提升显著。
AI.conclusion: 实验验证表明该框架在多种问题类型上均表现优异，尤其在时间和因果推理任务上优势显著，验证了层级结构保持设计的有效性。

title: Cross-Domain Data Selection and Augmentation for Automatic Compliance Detection
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. 11th Special Session on Intelligent Data Mining, 2025 IEEE International Conference on Big Data
summary: Automating the detection of regulatory compliance remains a challenging task due to the complexity and variability of legal texts. Models trained on one regulation often fail to generalise to others. This limitation underscores the need for principled methods to improve cross-domain transfer. We study data selection as a strategy to mitigate negative transfer in compliance detection framed as a natural language inference (NLI) task. Specifically, we evaluate four approaches for selecting augmentation data from a larger source domain: random sampling, Moore-Lewis's cross-entropy difference, importance weighting, and embedding-based retrieval. We systematically vary the proportion of selected data to analyse its effect on cross-domain adaptation. Our findings demonstrate that targeted data selection substantially reduces negative transfer, offering a practical path toward scalable and reliable compliance automation across heterogeneous regulations.

AI.tldr: 研究了数据选择策略对跨领域法规合规检测中负迁移的缓解作用，将合规检测建模为自然语言推理任务，评估了四种数据选择方法，发现针对性数据选择可显著减少负迁移。
AI.motivation: 当前法规合规自动检测面临挑战：在一个法规上训练的模型往往无法泛化到其他法规，凸显了提升跨领域迁移能力的迫切需求。
AI.method: 将合规检测任务框架化为自然语言推理（NLI）任务，系统评估四种数据选择方法：(1)随机采样；(2)Moore-Lewis交叉熵差值法；(3)重要性加权；(4)基于嵌入的检索。通过变化选中数据比例分析其对跨领域适应的影响。
AI.result: 针对性数据选择策略能够显著减少负迁移问题，有效提升跨领域合规检测的性能。
AI.conclusion: 数据选择为实现异构法规间可扩展、可靠的合规自动化提供了切实可行的路径。

title: Toward Efficient Membership Inference Attacks against Federated Large Language Models: A Projection Residual Approach
comment: This is the full version (including complete appendices and supplementary materials) of the paper accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy
summary: Federated Large Language Models (FedLLMs) enable multiple parties to collaboratively fine-tune LLMs without sharing raw data, addressing challenges of limited resources and privacy concerns. Despite data localization, shared gradients can still expose sensitive information through membership inference attacks (MIAs). However, FedLLMs' unique properties, i.e. massive parameter scales, rapid convergence, and sparse, non-orthogonal gradients, render existing MIAs ineffective. To address this gap, we propose ProjRes, the first projection residuals-based passive MIA tailored for FedLLMs. ProjRes leverages hidden embedding vectors as sample representations and analyzes their projection residuals on the gradient subspace to uncover the intrinsic link between gradients and inputs. It requires no shadow models, auxiliary classifiers, or historical updates, ensuring efficiency and robustness. Experiments on four benchmarks and four LLMs show that ProjRes achieves near 100% accuracy, outperforming prior methods by up to 75.75%, and remains effective even under strong differential privacy defenses. Our findings reveal a previously overlooked privacy vulnerability in FedLLMs and call for a re-examination of their security assumptions. Our code and data are available at $\href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Passive-MIA-5268}{link}$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ProjRes，这是首个专门针对联邦大语言模型的基于投影残差的被动成员推断攻击方法。该方法通过分析隐藏嵌入向量在梯度子空间上的投影残差来推断成员身份，无需辅助模型或历史数据即可实现接近100%的攻击准确率，揭示了FedLLMs中严重的隐私漏洞。
AI.motivation: 联邦大语言模型（FedLLMs）虽然避免了原始数据共享，但共享的梯度仍可通过成员推断攻击（MIAs）泄露敏感信息。然而，FedLLMs的独特属性（大规模参数、快速收敛、稀疏非正交梯度）使得现有MIAs方法失效，存在明显的安全鸿沟需要填补。
AI.method: ProjRes方法：利用隐藏嵌入向量作为样本表示，分析其在梯度子空间上的投影残差来揭示梯度与输入之间的内在联系。该方法无需阴影模型、辅助分类器或历史更新，仅利用当前的模型更新和隐藏状态即可实现攻击。
AI.result: ProjRes在四个基准数据集和四个LLM模型上实现了接近100%的准确率，比先前方法提升高达75.75%，且在强差分隐私防御下仍保持有效性。
AI.conclusion: ProjRes揭示了联邦大语言模型中一个被忽视的隐私漏洞，即使在强差分隐私防御下仍保持有效性。研究表明现有FedLLMs的安全假设需要重新审视，并呼吁开发更强大的防御机制来保护联邦学习中的敏感信息。

title: Preferences of a Voice-First Nation: Large-Scale Pairwise Evaluation and Preference Analysis for TTS in Indian Languages
summary: Crowdsourced pairwise evaluation has emerged as a scalable approach for assessing foundation models. However, applying it to Text to Speech(TTS) introduces high variance due to linguistic diversity and multidimensional nature of speech perception. We present a controlled multidimensional pairwise evaluation framework for multilingual TTS that combines linguistic control with perceptually grounded annotation. Using 5K+ native and code-mixed sentences across 10 Indic languages, we evaluate 7 state-of-the-art TTS systems and collect over 120K pairwise comparisons from over 1900 native raters. In addition to overall preference, raters provide judgments across 6 perceptual dimensions: intelligibility, expressiveness, voice quality, liveliness, noise, and hallucinations. Using Bradley-Terry modeling, we construct a multilingual leaderboard, interpret human preference using SHAP analysis and analyze leaderboard reliability alongside model strengths and trade-offs across perceptual dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于多语言TTS系统的控制性多维成对评估框架，通过1900+评分者在10种印度语言上收集超过12万对比较数据，使用Bradley-Terry模型构建排行榜，并用SHAP分析人类偏好。
AI.motivation: 众包成对评估应用于TTS时，由于语言多样性和语音感知的多维特性导致高方差，需要一种结合语言控制与感知驱动标注的评估框架。
AI.method: 采用控制性多维成对评估框架，涵盖5000+原生及代码混合句子，覆盖10种印度语言；评估7个SOTA TTS系统，收集超过12万对比较；评分者从6个感知维度（可懂度、表现力、声音质量、活力、噪声、幻觉）进行评判；使用Bradley-Terry模型和SHAP分析。
AI.result: 构建了多语言排行榜，通过SHAP解释了人类偏好，分析了排行榜可靠性及各模型在6个感知维度上的优势与权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为多语言TTS评估提供了可扩展且可靠的方案，能够捕捉模型在不同感知维度上的性能差异。

title: Efficient Agent Evaluation via Diversity-Guided User Simulation
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as customer-facing agents, yet evaluating their reliability remains challenging due to stochastic, multi-turn interactions. Current evaluation protocols rely on linear Monte Carlo rollouts of complete agent-user conversations to estimate success. However, this approach is computationally inefficient, repeatedly regenerating identical early prefixes, and often fails to uncover deep failure modes that arise from rare user behaviors.
  We introduce DIVERT (Diversity-Induced Evaluation via Branching of Trajectories), an efficient, snapshot-based, coverage-guided user simulation framework for systematic exploration of agent-user interactions. DIVERT captures the full agent-environment state at critical decision points and resumes execution from these snapshots, enabling reuse of shared conversation prefixes and reducing redundant computation. From each junction, the framework branches using targeted, diversity-inducing user responses, allowing directed exploration of alternative interaction paths.
  By focusing evaluation on semantically diverse and underexplored trajectories, DIVERT improves both efficiency and coverage. Empirical results show that it discovers more failures per token compared to standard linear rollout protocols, while expanding the set of tasks on which failures are identified.

title: ARFBench: Benchmarking Time Series Question Answering Ability for Software Incident Response
summary: Time series question-answering (TSQA), in which we ask natural language questions to infer and reason about properties of time series, is a promising yet underexplored capability of foundation models. In this work, we present ARFBench, a TSQA benchmark that evaluates the understanding of multimodal foundation models (FMs) on time series anomalies prevalent in software incident data. ARFBench consists of 750 questions across 142 time series and 5.38M data points from 63 production incidents sourced exclusively from internal telemetry at Datadog. We evaluate leading proprietary and open-source LLMs, VLMs, and time series FMs and observe that frontier VLMs perform markedly better than existing baselines; the leading model (GPT-5) achieves a 62.7% accuracy and 51.9% F1. We next demonstrate the promise of specialized multimodal approaches. We develop a novel TSFM + VLM hybrid prototype which we post-train on a small set of synthetic and real data that yields comparable overall F1 and accuracy with frontier models. Lastly, we find models and human domain experts exhibit complementary strengths. We define a model-expert oracle, a best-of-2 oracle selector over model and expert answers, yielding 82.8% F1 and 87.2% accuracy and establishing a new superhuman frontier for future TSQA models. The benchmark is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Datadog/ARFBench.

AI.tldr: ARFBench是一个时间序列问答基准测试，评估基础模型对软件事故中异常的推理能力。GPT-5等前沿VLM表现最佳，专用混合模型具竞争力，模型与专家结合可达87.2%准确率的超人类水平。
AI.motivation: 时间序列问答（TSQA）是有前景但尚未充分探索的能力，需要专门的基准来评估多模态基础模型对软件事故数据中时间序列异常的推理理解能力。
AI.method: 构建ARFBench基准（750题、142条时间序列、5.38M数据点）；评估多种模型（LLM、VLM、时间序列FM）；开发TSFM+VLM混合原型；定义模型-专家oracle选择器进行对比。
AI.result: 前沿VLM显著优于基线，GPT-5达62.7%准确率、51.9% F1；混合原型性能相当；模型-专家oracle达82.8% F1、87.2%准确率，实现超人类水平。
AI.conclusion: 该基准确立了TSQA的超人类前沿，为未来模型发展提供了评估基础，模型与人类专家的互补性为混合系统设计提供了方向。

title: OptiVerse: A Comprehensive Benchmark towards Optimization Problem Solving
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable reasoning, complex optimization tasks remain challenging, requiring domain knowledge and robust implementation. However, existing benchmarks focus narrowly on Mathematical Programming and Combinatorial Optimization, hindering comprehensive evaluation. To address this, we introduce OptiVerse, a comprehensive benchmark of 1,000 curated problems spanning neglected domains, including Stochastic Optimization, Dynamic Optimization, Game Optimization, and Optimal Control, across three difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, and Hard. The experiments with 22 LLMs of different sizes reveal sharp performance degradation on hard problems, where even advanced models like GPT-5.2 and Gemini-3 struggle to exceed 27% accuracy. Through error analysis, we identify that modeling & logic errors remain the primary bottleneck. Consequently, we propose a Dual-View Auditor Agent that improves the accuracy of the LLM modeling process without introducing significant time overhead. OptiVerse will serve as a foundational platform for advancing LLMs in solving complex optimization challenges.

AI.tldr: OptiVerse是一个综合性基准测试，包含1000个精选问题，涵盖随机优化、动态优化、博弈优化和最优控制等被忽视的领域，并提出Dual-View Auditor Agent提升LLM建模准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试仅聚焦于数学规划和组合优化，缺乏对LLM处理复杂优化任务的全面评估，且模型在难题上性能急剧下降。
AI.method: 构建OptiVerse基准（1000题，3难度级）；提出Dual-View Auditor Agent。
AI.result: 22个LLM在难题上性能急剧下降，GPT-5.2和Gemini-3准确率不超过27%；建模与逻辑错误是主要瓶颈；Dual-View Auditor Agent能提升建模准确性且时间开销小。
AI.conclusion: OptiVerse可作为推进LLM解决复杂优化问题的基础平台。

title: The Recurrent Transformer: Greater Effective Depth and Efficient Decoding
summary: Transformers process tokens in parallel but are temporally shallow: at position $t$, each layer attends to key-value pairs computed based on the previous layer, yielding a depth capped by the number of layers. Recurrent models offer unbounded temporal depth but suffer from optimization instability and historically underutilize modern accelerators. We introduce the Recurrent Transformer, a simple architectural change where each layer attends to key-value pairs computed off its own activations, yielding layerwise recurrent memory while preserving standard autoregressive decoding cost. We show that the architecture can emulate both (i) a conventional Transformer and (ii) token-to-token recurrent updates under mild assumptions, while avoiding optimization instability. Naively, prefill/training appears bandwidth-bound with effective arithmetic intensity near $1$ because keys and values are revealed sequentially; we give an exact tiling-based algorithm that preserves the mathematical computation while reducing HBM traffic from $Θ(N^2)$ to $Θ(N\log N)$, increasing effective arithmetic intensity to $Θ(N/\log N)$ for sequence length $N$. On 150M and 300M parameter C4 pretraining, Recurrent Transformers improve cross-entropy over a parameter-matched Transformer baseline and achieve the improvement with fewer layers (fixed parameters), suggesting that recurrence can trade depth for width, thus reducing KV cache memory footprint and inference latency.

title: Job Skill Extraction via LLM-Centric Multi-Module Framework
summary: Span-level skill extraction from job advertisements underpins candidate-job matching and labor-market analytics, yet generative large language models (LLMs) often yield malformed spans, boundary drift, and hallucinations, especially with long-tail terms and cross-domain shift. We present SRICL, an LLM-centric framework that combines semantic retrieval (SR), in-context learning (ICL), and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with a deterministic verifier. SR pulls in-domain annotated sentences and definitions from ESCO to form format-constrained prompts that stabilize boundaries and handle coordination. SFT aligns output behavior, while the verifier enforces pairing, non-overlap, and BIO legality with minimal retries. On six public span-labeled corpora of job-ad sentences across sectors and languages, SRICL achieves substantial STRICT-F1 improvements over GPT-3.5 prompting baselines and sharply reduces invalid tags and hallucinated spans, enabling dependable sentence-level deployment in low-resource, multi-domain settings.

title: GeoMind: An Agentic Workflow for Lithology Classification with Reasoned Tool Invocation
summary: Lithology classification in well logs is a fundamental geoscience data mining task that aims to infer rock types from multi dimensional geophysical sequences. Despite recent progress, existing approaches typically formulate the problem as a static, single-step discriminative mapping. This static paradigm limits evidence-based diagnostic reasoning against geological standards, often yielding predictions that are detached from geological reality due to a lack of domain priors. In this work, we propose GeoMind, a tool-augmented agentic framework that models lithology classification as a sequential reasoning process. GeoMind organizes its toolkit into perception, reasoning, and analysis modules, which respectively translate raw logs into semantic trends, infer lithology hypotheses from multi-source evidence, and verify predictions against stratigraphic constraints. A global planner adaptively coordinates these modules based on input characteristics, enabling geologically plausible and evidence-grounded decisions. To guarantee the logical consistency of GeoMind, we introduce a fine-grained process supervision strategy. Unlike standard methods that focus solely on final outcomes, our approach optimizes intermediate reasoning steps, ensuring the validity of decision trajectories and alignment to geological constraints. Experiments on four benchmark well-log datasets demonstrate that GeoMind consistently outperforms strong baselines in classification performance while providing transparent and traceable decision-making processes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GeoMind，一种将岩性分类建模为顺序推理过程的工具增强智能体框架。通过感知、推理、分析三模块协同工作，全局规划器自适应协调，基于细粒度过程监督确保决策轨迹有效性和地质约束一致性。实验证明该方法在分类性能和可解释性方面均优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将岩性分类问题形式化为静态单步判别映射，缺少领域先验知识，导致预测结果与地质实际脱节，无法进行基于证据的符合地质标准的诊断推理。
AI.method: (1) 构建了三模块工具包：感知模块将原始测井数据转化为语义趋势，推理模块从多源证据推断岩性假设，分析模块验证预测与地层约束的一致性；(2) 设计全局规划器自适应协调各模块；(3) 提出细粒度过程监督策略，优化中间推理步骤而非仅关注最终结果。
AI.result: GeoMind在四个基准测井数据集上持续优于强基线方法，既提升了分类性能，又提供了透明可追溯的决策过程。
AI.conclusion: GeoMind通过工具增强的智能体框架，结合全局规划器和过程监督机制，在四个基准数据集上实现了优于强基线的分类性能，同时提供了透明可追溯的决策过程。

title: Learning Dynamic Representations and Policies from Multimodal Clinical Time-Series with Informative Missingness
summary: Multimodal clinical records contain structured measurements and clinical notes recorded over time, offering rich temporal information about the evolution of patient health. Yet these observations are sparse, and whether they are recorded depends on the patient's latent condition. Observation patterns also differ across modalities, as structured measurements and clinical notes arise under distinct recording processes. While prior work has developed methods that accommodate missingness in clinical time series, how to extract and use the information carried by the observation process itself remains underexplored. We therefore propose a patient representation learning framework for multimodal clinical time series that explicitly leverages informative missingness. The framework combines (1) a multimodal encoder that captures signals from structured and textual data together with their observation patterns, (2) a Bayesian filtering module that updates a latent patient state over time from observed multimodal signals, and (3) downstream modules for offline treatment policy learning and patient outcome prediction based on the learned patient state. We evaluate the framework on ICU sepsis cohorts from MIMIC-III, MIMIC-IV, and eICU. It improves both offline treatment policy learning and adverse outcome prediction, achieving FQE 0.679 versus 0.528 for clinician behavior and AUROC 0.886 for post-72-hour mortality prediction on MIMIC-III.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种利用"信息性缺失"的多模态临床时序患者表征学习框架，通过多模态编码器、贝叶斯滤波和下游任务模块的级联设计，在ICU脓毒症队列上验证了其在治疗策略学习和结局预测任务上的有效性，尤其FQE提升约29%。
AI.motivation: 多模态临床记录（结构化测量+临床笔记）虽包含丰富的时序信息，但存在稀疏性问题，且不同模态的记录过程各异。现有方法虽能处理缺失值，但未能充分利用观察过程本身携带的诊断性信息。
AI.method: 提出一个多模态患者表征学习框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) 多模态编码器：从结构化数据和文本数据中提取特征，并显式建模观察模式；(2) 贝叶斯滤波模块：根据观察到的多模态信号更新潜在患者状态；(3) 下游任务模块：支持离线治疗策略学习和患者结局预测。
AI.result: FQE指标达0.679（基线0.528），MIMIC-III术后72小时死亡率预测AUROC达0.886。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在MIMIC-III、MIMIC-IV和eICU三个ICU脓毒症数据集上验证有效，在离线治疗策略学习和不良结局预测任务上均取得显著提升。FQE指标改善至0.679（vs 基线0.528），MIMIC-III术后72小时死亡率预测AUROC达0.886。

title: UKP_Psycontrol at SemEval-2026 Task 2: Modeling Valence and Arousal Dynamics from Text
summary: This paper presents our system developed for SemEval-2026 Task 2. The task requires modeling both current affect and short-term affective change in chronologically ordered user-generated texts. We explore three complementary approaches: (1) LLM prompting under user-aware and user-agnostic settings, (2) a pairwise Maximum Entropy (MaxEnt) model with Ising-style interactions for structured transition modeling, and (3) a lightweight neural regression model incorporating recent affective trajectories and trainable user embeddings. Our findings indicate that LLMs effectively capture static affective signals from text, whereas short-term affective variation in this dataset is more strongly explained by recent numeric state trajectories than by textual semantics. Our system ranked first among participating teams in both Subtask 1 and Subtask 2A based on the official evaluation metric.

title: BioMiner: A Multi-modal System for Automated Mining of Protein-Ligand Bioactivity Data from Literature
summary: Protein-ligand bioactivity data published in the literature are essential for drug discovery, yet manual curation struggles to keep pace with rapidly growing literature. Automated bioactivity extraction remains challenging because it requires not only interpreting biochemical semantics distributed across text, tables, and figures, but also reconstructing chemically exact ligand structures (e.g., Markush structures). To address this bottleneck, we introduce BioMiner, a multi-modal extraction framework that explicitly separates bioactivity semantic interpretation from ligand structure construction. Within BioMiner, bioactivity semantics are inferred through direct reasoning, while chemical structures are resolved via a chemical-structure-grounded visual semantic reasoning paradigm, in which multi-modal large language models operate on chemically grounded visual representations to infer inter-structure relationships, and exact molecular construction is delegated to domain chemistry tools. For rigorous evaluation and method development, we further establish BioVista, a comprehensive benchmark comprising 16,457 bioactivity entries curated from 500 publications. BioMiner validates its extraction ability and provides a quantitative baseline, achieving an F1 score of 0.32 for bioactivity triplets. BioMiner's practical utility is demonstrated via three applications: (1) extracting 82,262 data from 11,683 papers to build a pre-training database that improves downstream models performance by 3.9%; (2) enabling a human-in-the-loop workflow that doubles the number of high-quality NLRP3 bioactivity data, helping 38.6% improvement over 28 QSAR models and identification of 16 hit candidates with novel scaffolds; and (3) accelerating protein-ligand complex bioactivity annotation, achieving a 5.59-fold speed increase and 5.75% accuracy improvement over manual workflows in PoseBusters dataset.

AI.method: BioMiner采用多模态提取框架，将生物活性语义解释与配体结构构建显式分离。语义推理通过直接推理完成，化学结构解析采用化学结构引导的视觉语义推理范式——多模态大语言模型在化学基础视觉表示上推理结构关系，精确分子构建由领域化学工具完成。

title: CAP: Controllable Alignment Prompting for Unlearning in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) trained on unfiltered corpora inherently risk retaining sensitive information, necessitating selective knowledge unlearning for regulatory compliance and ethical safety. However, existing parameter-modifying methods face fundamental limitations: high computational costs, uncontrollable forgetting boundaries, and strict dependency on model weight access. These constraints render them impractical for closed-source models, yet current non-invasive alternatives remain unsystematic and reliant on empirical experience. To address these challenges, we propose the Controllable Alignment Prompting for Unlearning (CAP) framework, an end-to-end prompt-driven unlearning paradigm. CAP decouples unlearning into a learnable prompt optimization process via reinforcement learning, where a prompt generator collaborates with the LLM to suppress target knowledge while preserving general capabilities selectively. This approach enables reversible knowledge restoration through prompt revocation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CAP achieves precise, controllable unlearning without updating model parameters, establishing a dynamic alignment mechanism that overcomes the transferability limitations of prior methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAP框架，一种端到端基于提示的LLM知识遗忘方法，通过强化学习优化提示生成器实现选择性遗忘，避免参数更新，可通过撤销提示恢复知识，为闭源模型的合规需求提供可行方案。
AI.motivation: 当前参数修改方法存在根本性局限：高计算成本、不可控的遗忘边界、对模型权重访问的严格依赖。这些约束使其对闭源模型不切实际，而现有的非侵入式替代方案仍缺乏系统性且依赖经验探索。
AI.method: CAP框架采用端到端基于提示的遗忘范式，通过强化学习将遗忘过程解耦为可学习的提示优化过程，其中提示生成器与LLM协作以选择性抑制目标知识而保留通用能力。该方法支持通过撤销提示实现知识可逆恢复。

AI.conclusion: CAP establishes a dynamic alignment mechanism that overcomes the transferability limitations of prior methods, enabling practical knowledge unlearning for closed-source models without parameter updates.

title: Finding Meaning in Embeddings: Concept Separation Curves
comment: The code is open source and located on github at https://github.com/pkun-cbs/ConceptSeparationCurves. Original conference paper
summary: Sentence embedding techniques aim to encode key concepts of a sentence's meaning in a vector space. However, the majority of evaluation approaches for sentence embedding quality rely on the use of additional classifiers or downstream tasks. These additional components make it unclear whether good results stem from the embedding itself or from the classifier's behaviour. In this paper, we propose a novel method for evaluating the effectiveness of sentence embedding methods in capturing sentence-level concepts. Our approach is classifier-independent, allowing for an objective assessment of the model's performance. The approach adopted in this study involves the systematic introduction of syntactic noise and semantic negations into sentences, with the subsequent quantification of their relative effects on the resulting embeddings. The visualisation of these effects is facilitated by Concept Separation Curves, which show the model's capacity to differentiate between conceptual and surface-level variations. By leveraging data from multiple domains, employing both Dutch and English languages, and examining sentence lengths, this study offers a compelling demonstration that Concept Separation Curves provide an interpretable, reproducible, and cross-model approach for evaluating the conceptual stability of sentence embeddings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分类器无关的句子嵌入评估方法——概念分离曲线（Concept Separation Curves），通过系统引入句法噪声和语义否定来量化其对嵌入的影响，从而客观评估句子嵌入捕捉概念的能力。
AI.motivation: 当前句子嵌入质量评估高度依赖分类器或下游任务，导致难以区分性能提升源于嵌入本身还是分类器的行为。这使得对嵌入方法的客观评估存在根本性障碍。
AI.method: 1) 系统性地向句子引入句法噪声和语义否定；2) 量化这些变化对生成嵌入的影响；3) 通过概念分离曲线可视化模型区分概念层面与表面层面变化的能力；4) 在多领域、荷兰语/英语双语言环境下进行验证。
AI.result: 概念分离曲线能够有效展示模型区分概念变化和表面变化的能力，提供了可解释、可复现且跨模型的评估框架。
AI.conclusion: Concept Separation Curves为评估句子嵌入的概念稳定性提供了一种分类器无关、可解释、可复现且跨模型的评估方法，有望成为嵌入质量评估的标准工具。

title: Satisfying Rationality Postulates of Structured Argumentation Through Deductive Support -- Technical Report
summary: ASPIC-style structured argumentation frameworks provide a formal basis for reasoning in artificial intelligence by combining internal argument structure with abstract argumentation semantics. A key challenge in these frameworks is ensuring compliance with five critical rationality postulates: closure, direct consistency, indirect consistency, non-interference, and crash-resistance. Recent approaches, including ASPIC$^{\ominus}$ and Deductive ASPIC$-$, have made significant progress but fall short of meeting all postulates simultaneously under a credulous semantics (e.g. preferred) in the presence of undercuts. This paper introduces Deductive ASPIC$^{\ominus}$, a novel framework that integrates gen-rebuttals from ASPIC$^{\ominus}$ with the Joint Support Bipolar Argumentation Frameworks (JSBAFs) of Deductive ASPIC$-$, incorporating preferences. We show that Deductive ASPIC$^{\ominus}$ satisfies all five rationality postulates under a version of preferred semantics. This work opens new avenues for further research on robust and logically sound structured argumentation systems.

title: Improving Performance in Classification Tasks with LCEN and the Weighted Focal Differentiable MCC Loss
summary: The LASSO-Clip-EN (LCEN) algorithm was previously introduced for nonlinear, interpretable feature selection and machine learning. However, its design and use was limited to regression tasks. In this work, we create a modified version of the LCEN algorithm that is suitable for classification tasks and maintains its desirable properties, such as interpretability. This modified LCEN algorithm is evaluated on four widely used binary and multiclass classification datasets. In these experiments, LCEN is compared against 10 other model types and consistently reaches high test-set macro F$_1$ score and Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) metrics, higher than that of the majority of investigated models. LCEN models for classification remain sparse, eliminating an average of 56% of all input features in the experiments performed. Furthermore, LCEN-selected features are used to retrain all models using the same data, leading to statistically significant performance improvements in three of the experiments and insignificant differences in the fourth when compared to using all features or other feature selection methods. Simultaneously, the weighted focal differentiable MCC (diffMCC) loss function is evaluated on the same datasets. Models trained with the diffMCC loss function are always the best-performing methods in these experiments, and reach test-set macro F$_1$ scores that are, on average, 4.9% higher and MCCs that are 8.5% higher than those obtained by models trained with the weighted cross-entropy loss. These results highlight the performance of LCEN as a feature selection and machine learning algorithm also for classification tasks, and how the diffMCC loss function can train very accurate models, surpassing the weighted cross-entropy loss in the tasks investigated.

AI.motivation: LCEN算法最初仅适用于回归任务，作者希望将其扩展到分类任务并保持其可解释性等优良特性。
AI.method: 开发了改进版LCEN算法用于分类任务；在4个二分类和多分类数据集上评估；与10种其他模型类型对比；使用diffMCC损失函数训练模型并与加权交叉熵损失对比。
AI.result: LCEN达到较高的macro F1和MCC指标，优于大多数对比模型；LCEN模型保持稀疏性，平均消除56%的输入特征；使用LCEN选择的特征重训练其他模型，在3/4实验中获得统计学显著的性能提升；diffMCC损失函数训练的模型始终表现最佳，比加权交叉熵损失平均提升4.9% F1和8.5% MCC。
AI.conclusion: LCEN作为一种特征选择和机器学习算法同样适用于分类任务；diffMCC损失函数能够训练出比加权交叉熵损失更精确的模型，在所研究的任务中表现优异。

title: Measuring Opinion Bias and Sycophancy via LLM-based Coercion
summary: Large language models increasingly shape the information people consume: they are embedded in search, consulted for professional advice, deployed as agents, and used as a first stop for questions about policy, ethics, health, and politics. When such a model silently holds a position on a contested topic, that position propagates at scale into users' decisions. Eliciting a model's positions is harder than it first appears: contemporary assistants answer direct opinion questions with evasive disclaimers, and the same model may concede the opposite position once the user starts arguing one side. We propose a method, released as the open-source llm-bias-bench, for discovering the opinions an LLM actually holds on contested topics under conditions that resemble real multi-turn interaction. The method pairs two complementary free-form probes. Direct probing asks for the model's opinion across five turns of escalating pressure from a simulated user. Indirect probing never asks for an opinion and engages the model in argumentative debate, letting bias leak through how it concedes, resists, or counter-argues. Three user personas (neutral, agree, disagree) collapse into a nine-way behavioral classification that separates persona-independent positions from persona-dependent sycophancy, and an auditable LLM judge produces verdicts with textual evidence. The first instantiation ships 38 topics in Brazilian Portuguese across values, scientific consensus, philosophy, and economic policy. Applied to 13 assistants, the method surfaces findings of practical interest: argumentative debate triggers sycophancy 2-3x more than direct questioning (median 50% to 79%); models that look opinionated under direct questioning often collapse into mirroring under sustained arguments; and attacker capability matters mainly when an existing opinion must be dislodged, not when the assistant starts neutral.

title: The CriticalSet problem: Identifying Critical Contributors in Bipartite Dependency Networks
summary: Identifying critical nodes in complex networks is a fundamental task in graph mining. Yet, methods addressing an all-or-nothing coverage mechanics in a bipartite dependency network, a graph with two types of nodes where edges represent dependency relationships across the two groups only, remain largely unexplored. We formalize the CriticalSet problem: given an arbitrary bipartite graph modeling dependencies of items on contributors, identify the set of k contributors whose removal isolates the largest number of items. We prove that this problem is NP-hard and requires maximizing a supermodular set function, for which standard forward greedy algorithms provide no approximation guarantees. Consequently, we model CriticalSet as a coalitional game, deriving a closed-form centrality, ShapleyCov, based on the Shapley value. This measure can be interpreted as the expected number of items isolated by a contributor's departure. Leveraging these insights, we propose MinCov, a linear-time iterative peeling algorithm that explicitly accounts for connection redundancy, prioritizing contributors who uniquely support many items. Extensive experiments on synthetic and large-scale real datasets, including a Wikipedia graph with over 250 million edges, reveal that MinCov and ShapleyCov significantly outperform traditional baselines. Notably, MinCov achieves near-optimal performance, within 0.02 AUC of a Stochastic Hill Climbing metaheuristic, while remaining several orders of magnitude faster.
